https://www.inquirer.net/495901/west-ph-.body: “If we want to influence the South China Sea in 2031, we must recognize that strategic competition has changed,” Oban said in his opening remarks at the Manila Dialogue on the South China Sea. His remarks came as China continued to exert maritime pressure in the South China Sea, a strategic waterway through which trillions of dollars in trade pass annually and where Philippine and Chinese vessels have been involved in recurring collisions and confrontations. Beijing’s claim is based on a nine-dash line map dating to the 1940s that encompasses the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone (EEZ), part of which Manila calls the West Philippine Sea. A United Nations-backed tribunal invalidated China’s claim in 2016, ruling that it had no legal basis under international law. “Strategic competition must never make coercion an accepted means of managing differences,” he said. “Preventing armed conflict remains essential, but preventing the gradual erosion of regional maritime order is primordial.” And he noted that a five-year horizon through 2031 will prove decisive in determining whether international rules prevail over “coercion and unilateral actions” in the South China Sea. “Several developments will shape this period, including China’s continuing military modernization, the Philippines’ next national security planning cycle, and Asean’s implementation of regional economic and security priorities,” Oban said. READ: Ridon: We respect ties with China, but West Philippine Sea is ours For the Philippines, he said, the path to 2031 requires forging deeper security alliances without sacrificing diplomatic boundaries, while bolstering regional mechanisms for maritime safety, including that Asean and its partners must translate commitments into practical arrangements to prevent incidents at sea. Building greater national resilience by fortifying the country’s physical and digital infrastructure to reduce systemic vulnerabilities should also be a priority, he added. https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.body: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. should prioritize trade, investment, and regional economic integration at the 33rd Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting in China, moving beyond geopolitical issues to advance the Philippines’ interests. China is the world’s second-largest economy by nominal gross domestic product (GDP) and the largest by purchasing power parity. Hosting the Apec meeting will help set the tone for how member economies pursue economic growth and cooperation. READ: Marcos to CEOs at Apec Summit: ‘PH open, ready, and eager’ After concluding the Philippines’ hosting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summits and Related Summits on Nov. 17 in Manila, Marcos will fly to China’s “Silicon Valley,” Shenzhen, on Nov. 18 to represent the nation at the economy-centered meeting. Apec serves as a regional economic forum that leverages the growing interdependence of the Asia-Pacific. It aims to ensure that goods, services, investment, and people move easily across borders. In November 1989, the Philippines and 11 other founding countries—Australia, Brunei Darussalam, Canada, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, New Zealand, Singapore, Thailand, and the United States—established it in Canberra, Australia. Hong Kong, China, and Chinese Taipei joined in 1991, followed by Mexico and Papua New Guinea in 1993, and Chile in 1994. Four years later, Peru, Russia, and Viet Nam joined as well, bringing the full membership to 21. This year marks China’s third time hosting the meeting, following Shanghai in 2001 and Beijing in 2014. Apec chose Shenzhen, a major technology and manufacturing hub in South China, as its host city. What started as a humble fishing village has transformed into an economic and technology center. Now, it will showcase China’s economic modernization, technological prowess, and reform and opening-up policy. Under the theme “Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together,” China set the core priorities: open trade, digital economy and AI growth, and regional connectivity and inclusion. At the 37th Apec Ministerial Meeting in Beijing, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said China is ready to collaborate with member economies to build a progressive Asia-Pacific community. READ: China, ASEAN make progress on SCS pact but can’t finish talks this year The 21 Apec member economies account for around 61 to 62 percent of the global gross domestic product. In this context, Wang called on members to uphold the multilateral trading system under the World Trade Organization. He also underscored the importance of collective efforts to build an innovation ecosystem, accelerate digital and intelligent transformation, and open up new areas for cooperation. For his part, Commerce Minister Wang Wentao said member economies should pursue the Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific and eliminate trade and investment obstacles. Additionally, he said member economies should explore a trust-based partnership in the digital and AI economies. China, along with the United States, is a leading country in AI, and its roadmap for the years ahead will be a main topic at the leaders’ meeting. Various meetings have already occurred ahead of the leaders’ meeting on November 18 to 19. These include the 2026 APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting held in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the 12th Apec Transport Ministers’ Meeting in Beijing. The 4th Apec Business Advisory Council Meeting runs from November 14 to 16, followed by the Apec Ministerial Meeting on November 16 and 17 and the APEC CEO Summit on November 17 and 18. READ: AFP to VP: Defending PH rights isn’t ‘picking a fight with China’ Like Marcos, US President Donald Trump will head to Shenzhen after the 49th Asean Summit for potential bilateral talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Similarly, Russian President Vladimir Putin, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, and South Korean President Lee Jae-myung will also reportedly attend the event. While details of Marcos’ agenda on the sidelines of the Apec Leaders’ Meeting have yet to be provided, the public is watching for the possibility of bilateral meetings with Xi and Trump, although these remain long shots. To recall, Marcos met with the host country’s leader, Lee, during the 32nd Apec meeting in Gyeongju, South Korea, in 2025. Also, Marcos will likely use the economy-focused Apec CEO Summit to woo investors to the Philippines amid global turbulence. Member economies will release an Apec Leaders’ Declaration, a document that outlines their collective agreements, commitments, and strategic goals. They will also announce their commitments on regional trade and investment while updating the public on the agreements reached regarding AI and digital trade. Meanwhile, the public eagerly anticipates hearing about the concerns Filipino businesses raise regarding regional economic integration and whether Marcos will address maritime issues during his meetings. /pai
https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.title_zh: 马科斯在中国举行的亚太经合组织峰会上面临平衡各方关系 challenge
https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.body_zh: 马尼拉，菲律宾——菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 应在中国举行的第33届亚太经合组织经济领导人会议上优先推动贸易、投资和区域经济一体化，超越地缘政治问题，以促进菲律宾利益。中国按名义国内生产总值计算是世界第二大经济体，按购买力平价计算则位居第一。主办此次亚太经合组织会议将有助于为各成员经济体追求经济增长与合作确立方向。阅读：马科斯在亚太经合组织峰会上对首席执行官们表示：“菲律宾开放、准备就绪，充满期待”。菲律宾于11月17日在马尼拉结束东南亚国家联盟峰会及相关峰会的承办工作后，马科斯将于11月18日飞往中国“硅谷”深圳，代表国家出席这场以经济为中心的会议。亚太经合组织是一个区域经济论坛，利用亚太地区日益增强的相互依存关系。其目标是确保货物、服务、投资和人员跨境自由流动。1989年11月，菲律宾与另外11个创始国——澳大利亚、文莱达鲁萨兰、加拿大、印度尼西亚、日本、韩国、马来西亚、新西兰、新加坡、泰国和美国——在澳大利亚堪培拉共同创立了该组织。1991年，中国香港和中华台北加入，随后墨西哥和巴布亚新几内亚于1993年加入，智利于1994年加入。四年后，秘鲁、俄罗斯和越南也加入，使正式成员数量增至21个。今年是中国第三次主办该会议，此前曾于2001年和2014年分别在上海和北京举行。亚太经合组织选择中国南方重要的技术和制造业中心深圳作为主办城市。这个曾经不起眼的渔村如今已转型为经济和科技中心。现在，深圳将展示中国的经济现代化、技术实力以及改革开放政策。中国以“建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣”为主题，确定了核心优先事项：推进贸易开放、数字经济和人工智能增长，以及加强区域互联互通与包容。在北京举行的第37届亚太经合组织部长级会议上，中国外交部长王毅表示，中国愿与各成员经济体合作，建设开放进步的亚太共同体。阅读：中国与东盟在南海行为准则问题上取得进展，但今年无法完成谈判。亚太经合组织21个成员经济体约占全球国内生产总值的61%至62%。在此背景下，王毅呼吁成员维护世界贸易组织框架下的多边贸易体系。他还强调，要通过集体努力建设创新生态系统、加快数字化和智能化转型，并开辟新的合作领域。商务部长王文涛则表示，各成员经济体应推进亚太自由贸易区建设，消除贸易和投资障碍。他还表示，各成员经济体应探索建立数字经济和人工智能经济中的互信伙伴关系。中国与美国是人工智能领域的领先国家，未来数年的发展路线图将是领导人会议的主要议题之一。在11月18日至19日的领导人会议之前，各场会议已陆续举行，其中包括在香港特别行政区举行的2026年亚太经合组织财长会议，以及在北京举行的第12届亚太经合组织交通部长会议。第4届亚太经合组织工商咨询理事会会议于11月14日至16日举行，随后是11月16日至17日的亚太经合组织部长级会议，以及11月17日至18日的亚太经合组织首席执行官峰会。阅读：法新社致菲律宾副总统：捍卫菲律宾权利并非“与中国发生冲突”。与马科斯一样，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将在第49届东盟峰会后前往深圳，可能与中国国家主席习近平举行双边会谈。据报道，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京、日本首相高市早苗和韩国总统李在明也将出席该活动。尽管亚太经合组织领导人会议边会活动的安排尚未公布，但公众仍在关注马科斯是否可能与习近平和特朗普举行双边会谈，尽管这种可能性仍然不大。回顾一下，2025年亚太经合组织会议在韩国庆州举行时，马科斯曾与东道国领导人李在明会面。此外，在全球经济动荡之际，马科斯很可能利用以经济为重点的亚太经合组织首席执行官峰会吸引投资者赴菲律宾。各成员经济体将发布《亚太经合组织领导人宣言》，概述各方共同达成的协议、承诺和战略目标。各方还将宣布在区域贸易和投资方面的承诺，并就人工智能和数字贸易达成的协议向公众通报。与此同时，公众也热切期待了解菲律宾企业对区域经济一体化的关切，以及马科斯是否会在会议期间处理海上问题。 /pai

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism will host a forum Tuesday on how artificial intelligence (AI) is being used in culture, sports and tourism and on how these sectors should shift to AI. The ministry said Monday the fourth Culture, Sports and Tourism Digital Innovation Forum, themed “New Culture Through AI,” will be held at L Tower in Seoul’s Seocho District. About 400 people from government, public institutions and the private sector are expected to attend. State-affiliated bodies are co-organizing the event, including the Korea Culture Information Service Agency, Arts Council Korea, the Korea Sports Promotion Foundation, the Korea Tourism Organization and the Korea Creative Content Agency. The forum will open with an awards ceremony for 15 winners of an AI and cultural data contest. They were chosen in five categories across three fields: new technology, cultural data use and data analysis. Five winners will receive the culture minister’s award. Winning entries include an AI service that lets users talk with historical figures based on historical records and an AI service that rearranges music for people with cochlear implants. Another is a customized AI service for children based on traditional folk tales. A Sungkyunkwan University professor will give the keynote speech on how to live in a world being reshaped by AI. Four breakout sessions will follow on AI in culture and sports, the arts, tourism and content. Topics include responsible use of AI in artistic creation, robots and real-time translation in tourism and AI strategies for visual effects and gaming. At booths in the venue, visitors can try generative AI photo services, AI-based body shape analysis with personalized workout recommendations and real-time interpretation. “The ministry will continue to expand the use of cultural data and support the AI transition in the field to spread digital innovation that people can feel,” a ministry official said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 韩国文化、体育和旅游部将于周二举办一场论坛，讨论人工智能如何应用于文化、体育和旅游领域，以及这些领域应如何转向人工智能。该部周一表示，第四届文化、体育和旅游数字创新论坛将以“人工智能赋能新文化”为主题，在首尔瑞草区L Tower举行。预计约400名政府、公共机构和私营部门人士出席。韩国文化信息院、韩国艺术委员会、韩国体育振兴基金会、韩国观光公社和韩国创意内容 agency's等国有机构将联合主办活动。论坛将以人工智能与文化数据竞赛15名获奖者的颁奖典礼开幕。获奖者来自新技术、文化数据应用和数据分析三个领域的五个类别。其中5名获奖者将获得文化部长奖。获奖作品包括一项人工智能服务，用户可依据历史记录与历史人物交谈；另一项人工智能服务，可为使用人工耳蜗的人重新编排音乐；还有一项面向儿童的定制人工智能服务，基于传统民间故事创作。成均馆大学的一名教授将发表主旨演讲，探讨如何在一个正被人工智能重塑的世界中生活。随后将举行四场分组会议，议题包括文化与体育领域的人工智能、艺术、旅游和内容。讨论主题包括负责任地将人工智能用于艺术创作、旅游领域的机器人应用和实时翻译，以及用于视觉特效和游戏的人工智能战略。现场展台上，参观者可以体验生成式人工智能照片服务、基于人工智能的体型分析及个性化健身建议，以及实时口译。该部官员表示：“该部将继续扩大文化数据的应用，并支持各领域向人工智能转型，推动让民众切实感受到的数字创新。”本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Pulmuone Food & Culture opened its first overseas contract catering operation in the United States, bringing Korean food to a workplace in Arizona as the company looks to expand its food service business across North America. The food service subsidiary of Pulmuone said Monday that it began operating a cafeteria at a Korean conglomerate's facility in Queen Creek, Arizona, marking its first overseas contract catering operation. The operation is run through Pulmuone FNC USA, the company's U.S. subsidiary established in January, and occupies 175 pyeong, or about 578 square meters, including dining and kitchen areas. The cafeteria currently serves lunch and dinner, with menus designed for both Korean employees and local staff. Its offerings follow a dual-track approach, combining traditional Korean dishes with familiar American meals. Korean options include galbijjim, or braised short ribs, and kimchi jjigae, a stew made from the pungent cabbage pickle, along with side dishes, gimbap and instant noodles. The facility also features a Korean Station serving restaurant-style dishes, a Grab & Go section for convenient Korean meals and a Private Dining Room offering full Korean meal sets. An American Station provides familiar local dishes for employees who prefer Western-style food. The company said the approach is intended to give Korean employees convenient access to familiar meals while introducing American workers to the cuisine amid growing local interest in Korean food culture. Lee Dong-hoon, CEO of Pulmuone Food & Culture, said the opening marked an important step in bringing the company's domestic catering expertise to overseas markets. “Launching our first North American operation is highly significant because it marks our first step into overseas markets, backed by recognition of the contract catering capabilities and menu competitiveness we have developed in Korea,” Lee said. “We will work to establish our first overseas operation quickly and grow into a competitive food service company in global markets,” he said. Pulmuone Food & Culture plans to use the Arizona operation as a base for expanding into facilities run by other Korean companies in North America. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Pulmuone Food & Culture在美国开设首家海外餐饮业务
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: Pulmuone Food & Culture在美国开设了首个海外合同餐饮业务，将韩国料理带到亚利桑那州的一处工作场所，该公司正谋求将餐饮服务业务拓展至北美各地。Pulmuone旗下餐饮服务子公司周一表示，已开始在亚利桑那州皇后克里克一家韩国大型企业的设施内运营食堂，标志着其首个海外合同餐饮项目投入运营。该业务通过公司今年1月成立的美国子公司Pulmuone FNC USA运营，占地175坪，约合578平方米，包括用餐区和厨房区域。食堂目前供应午餐和晚餐，菜单同时面向韩国籍员工和当地员工设计。其餐饮采用双轨模式，将传统韩国菜式与美国人熟悉的餐食结合起来。韩国料理包括烤牛排（galbijjim）和泡菜汤（kimchi jjigae），后者是一种以辛辣泡菜制成的炖菜，此外还供应各种小菜、紫菜包饭和即食面条。设施内还设有供应餐厅式菜肴的Korean Station、方便购买韩国料理的即取即走区（Grab & Go），以及提供完整韩式套餐的独立包间（Private Dining Room）。American Station则为偏爱西式餐饮的员工供应当地熟悉的菜肴。公司表示，这一运营模式旨在让韩国籍员工方便地吃到熟悉的饭菜，同时让美国员工接触韩国餐饮文化；目前当地对韩国饮食文化的兴趣正不断上升。Pulmuone Food & Culture首席执行官Lee Dong-hoon表示，此次开业标志着将公司在国内积累的餐饮服务经验推广至海外市场的重要一步。Lee说：“在北美启动首个运营项目意义重大，因为这是我们迈入海外市场的第一步，其背后是我们凭借在韩国积累的合同餐饮能力和菜单竞争力所获得的认可。我们将努力迅速建立首个海外运营项目，并成长为全球市场上具有竞争力的餐饮服务公司。”Pulmuone Food & Culture计划以亚利桑那州业务为据点，拓展至北美地区其他韩国企业运营的设施。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: The unification ministry said Monday it is closely watching a senior North Korean official's trip to Moscow, which comes just days before a planned summit of the leaders of the United States, China and Russia. Jo Yong-won, a secretary of the Central Committee of the ruling Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), has been visiting Moscow since Saturday as the head of a party and government delegation, according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). He is known as a close aide to North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. The KCNA said the visit comes as the "militant friendship" and "relations of alliance" between Pyongyang and Moscow grow stronger "with each passing day." The purpose and schedule of the trip have not been disclosed. "It is a high-level exchange between North Korea and Russia right before this week's planned summit," ministry spokesperson Yoon Min-ho said at a regular briefing Monday. "We will watch closely what Jo's role would be as head of both a party and a government delegation," he said, drawing a contrast with Kim Song-nam, a member of the WPK's Political Bureau and party secretary, who traveled to China earlier this month on a party-to-party visit. Jo's trip comes days before U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are due to meet on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday. It is the latest in a run of high-level overtures from Pyongyang to China and Russia. It has fueled speculation that the North is seeking to build diplomatic leverage ahead of any talks with Washington

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: HD Hyundai, a Korean shipbuilding, heavy machinery and energy conglomerate, will showcase its latest solar power, energy storage and power grid technologies at North America’s largest clean energy exhibition this week, as the industrial group seeks to expand its presence in the rapidly growing U.S. energy market.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: HD现代是韩国一家涵盖造船、重型机械和能源业务的大型企业集团。本周，该集团将在北美最大的清洁能源展览会上展示其最新光伏发电、储能和电网技术，同时寻求扩大自身在快速增长的美国能源市场中的影响力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: HD Hyundai, a Korean shipbuilding, heavy machinery and energy conglomerate, will showcase its latest solar power, energy storage and power grid technologies at North America’s largest clean energy exhibition this week, as the industrial group seeks to expand its presence in the rapidly growing U.S. energy market. HD Hyundai Energy Solutions and HD Hyundai Electric will jointly participate in RE+ 2026, which runs from Tuesday through Thursday at Las Vegas Convention Center, company officials said Monday. The two affiliates will present technologies spanning solar power generation, energy storage and conversion, and electricity transmission and distribution, highlighting their integrated capabilities across energy infrastructure. HD Hyundai Energy Solutions will unveil its G12R TOPCon Multi-Cut solar module in North America for first time, featuring technology that divides large-area solar cells into smaller sections to reduce power losses during current transmission. The technology enables module efficiency of 24.4 percent by increasing power density, with company planning to gradually introduce advanced Multi-Cut technology across its production lines. HD Hyundai Electric will showcase battery energy storage systems (BESS) and technologies designed to stabilize power grids, including its 96-megawatt Anjwa Island project in Korea’s Sinan County and 100-megawatt Rutile project in Texas. It will also introduce grid-forming technology, which actively controls grid voltage and frequency to improve electricity supply stability, alongside power equipment targeting North American electricity networks and data centers. “Technical capabilities of products, as well as stable supply capacity and project execution capabilities, are emerging as key competitive factors in North American market,” an HD Hyundai official said. “Through this exhibition, we will expand cooperation with local customers and partners and identify tangible business opportunities,” the official said. HD Hyundai Electric is expanding its North American manufacturing operations and BESS business through its Texas subsidiary, while HD Hyundai Energy Solutions is leveraging its integrated domestic solar cell and module production system to address changing U.S. supply chain regulations, including foreign entity of concern requirements. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: HD现代利用太阳能和电池技术瞄准北美能源市场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: HD Hyundai是一家韩国的造船、重型机械和能源综合企业。本周，该集团将在北美最大的清洁能源展览会上展示其最新的太阳能发电、储能及电网技术。目前，这家工业集团正寻求扩大在快速发展的美国能源市场中的业务存在。公司官员周一表示，HD Hyundai Energy Solutions与HD Hyundai Electric将联合参加RE+ 2026，展会将于周二至周四在拉斯维加斯会展中心举行。两家关联公司将展示涵盖太阳能发电、储能与能量转换以及输配电领域的各项技术，重点突出其在能源基础设施方面的综合能力。HD Hyundai Energy Solutions将首次在北美发布G12R TOPCon Multi-Cut太阳能组件。该技术将大面积太阳能电池片分割成更小的部分，以减少电流传输过程中的功率损耗。通过提高功率密度，该技术可使组件效率达到24.4%，公司还计划逐步在各条生产线引入先进的Multi-Cut技术。HD Hyundai Electric将展示电池储能系统（BESS）以及旨在稳定电网的技术，包括其位于韩国 신안郡的96兆瓦Anjwa Island项目和位于得克萨斯州的100兆瓦Rutile项目。该公司还将推出构网型技术，通过主动控制电网电压和频率来提高供电稳定性，并展示面向北美电网和数据中心的电力设备。HD Hyundai一名官员表示：“产品的技术能力、稳定的供应能力以及项目执行能力，正逐渐成为北美市场的关键竞争因素。”该官员说：“我们将通过这次展览扩大与当地客户和合作伙伴的合作，并发掘切实可行的商业机会。”HD Hyundai Electric正通过其得克萨斯州子公司扩大北美制造业务和BESS业务；与此同时，HD Hyundai Energy Solutions正利用其一体化国内太阳能电池片和组件生产体系，应对美国不断变化的供应链法规，包括受关注外国实体要求。本文由生成式人工智能协助创作，并由《韩国时报》编辑

Religious organizations can also link transaction data to their financial management systems, making it easier to issue donation receipts for year-end tax deductions.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary_zh: 韩国大型银行正积极争取宗教群体，以扩大客户群。行业官员周一表示，这些银行提供量身定制的服务，例如移动捐赠平台，以及可兼作宗教团体会员卡的借记卡。宗教组织还可以将交易数据接入其财务管理系统，从而更方便地开具捐赠收据，供持有人在年底申报税务抵扣。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body: Korea's major banks are courting religious communities to expand their customer base, offering tailored services such as mobile donation platforms and debit cards that double as membership cards for religious groups, industry officials said Monday. Hana Bank's mobile donation service for religious organizations processed 68 billion won ($51 million) in donations from January through October this year, according to the bank. This is a sharp increase from the 350 million won recorded in 2020, when the service was first introduced. The service allows worshippers at churches and Buddhist temples to make donations using QR codes, without having to install a separate app. Religious organizations can also link transaction data to their financial management systems, making it easier to issue donation receipts for year-end tax deductions. Hana Bank also offers a trust product that allows customers to leave part or all of their assets to religious organizations after their death. Since launching the product in July 2021, the bank has partnered with 12 religious organizations and signed trust agreements worth a combined 24.8 billion won. Woori Bank's Catholic donation service, Catholic Pay, had attracted more than 110,000 registered users as of October, nearly nine times the 12,790 users recorded when it was launched in 2023. The service is integrated into the Archdiocese of Seoul's mobile app, allowing users to register their bank accounts and transfer Sunday offerings and other donations. Woori also signed an agreement with the archdiocese to support the 2027 World Youth Day, an international gathering of Catholic youth scheduled to take place in Seoul in August next year. KB Kookmin Bank also operates a donation transfer service that was initially launched for Christian communities in 2020 before being expanded to include Buddhist and Catholic groups in 2023. Its transaction volume rose 4.5 percent last year, according to the bank. Shinhan Bank, for its part, signed an agreement with the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism in March to develop a debit card that also serves as a membership card for Buddhist followers. The two sides also plan to build a digital platform to help temples manage their members. Banks' growing interest in religious communities comes as Korea had an estimated 20.73 million religious adherents in 2025, including 9.33 million Christians, 8.29 million Buddhists and 3.11 million Catholics, according to Gallup Korea. Mobile donation services first gained traction during the COVID-19 pandemic, when social distancing measures pushed religious groups to move worship services online. Their use has continued to grow since then, industry officials said. For banks, religious groups offer a way to expand their customer base and build lasting relationships. "Religious affiliation often runs in families. When parents start using a service, their children often follow suit, helping banks build customer relationships across generations. Services also tend to spread quickly through religious communities, as members recommend them to one another," a banking industry official said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title_zh: 银行以定制化金融服务争取宗教社群
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body_zh: 韩国大型银行正积极争取宗教团体，以扩大客户群并提供定制化服务，例如移动捐赠平台，以及兼作宗教团体会员卡的借记卡。业内人士周一表示。Hana Bank面向宗教组织的移动捐赠服务今年1月至10月共处理了680亿韩元（5100万美元）的捐赠。据该行称，这一数字较服务首次推出的2020年所记录的3.5亿韩元大幅增长。这项服务允许教堂和佛教寺庙的信众使用二维码捐款，无需另行安装应用程序。宗教组织还可将交易数据接入其财务管理系统，从而更方便地开具年末抵税所需的捐赠收据。Hana Bank还提供一项信托产品，允许客户去世后将部分或全部资产留给宗教组织。自2021年7月推出以来，该行已与12个宗教组织建立合作，并签署了总额248亿韩元的信托协议。截至10月，Woori Bank的天主教捐赠服务Catholic Pay吸引了超过11万名注册用户，接近该服务于2023年推出时记录的12790名用户的九倍。这项服务已接入首尔大主教的移动应用程序，允许用户登记银行账户并划转主日奉献及其他捐款。Woori还与首尔大主教签署协议，将支持2027年世界青年日。这一天主教青年国际聚会定于明年8月在首尔举行。KB Kookmin Bank也运营一项捐赠转账服务，该服务最初于2020年面向基督教团体推出，随后于2023年扩展至佛教和天主教团体。据该行称，其交易额去年增长了4.5%。Shinhan Bank则于3月与韩国佛教曹溪宗签署协议，开发一张兼作佛教信众会员卡的借记卡。双方还计划建立一个数字平台，帮助寺庙管理会员。据Gallup Korea称，2025年韩国估计有2073万名宗教信仰者，其中基督徒933万人、佛教徒829万人、天主教徒311万人。业内人士表示，移动捐赠服务在新冠疫情期间首次获得广泛使用，当时保持社交距离的措施促使宗教团体将礼拜活动转移到线上。此后，这类服务的使用量持续增长。对银行而言，宗教团体为扩大客户群、建立长久客户关系提供了一条途径。一位银行业人士表示：“宗教信仰往往会代代相传。父母开始使用某项服务后，其子女往往会效仿，帮助银行建立跨世代的客户关系。服务也容易通过宗教群体迅速传播，因为成员之间会相互推荐。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Oh Hyun-joo, a career diplomat who previously served as a deputy director at the presidential National Security Office, took office Monday as the 15th president of the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), the state-run foreign aid agency.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 职业外交官Oh Hyun-joo曾任总统府国家安全办公室副主任，她于周一就任韩国国际合作机构（KOICA）第15任社长。该机构是韩国政府运营的对外援助机构。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Oh Hyun-joo, a career diplomat who previously served as a deputy director at the presidential National Security Office, took office Monday as the 15th president of the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), the state-run foreign aid agency. KOICA is Korea’s main agency for carrying out the government’s grant aid programs for developing countries. It was founded in 1991. An inauguration ceremony was held the same day at its headquarters in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province. Oh graduated from Korea University with a degree in Spanish language and literature and earned a master’s degree in international relations from the University of Cambridge. She joined the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 1994 after passing the foreign service exam. Her key posts include director of the ministry’s development cooperation division, counselor at Korea’s mission in Geneva, special adviser to the president of the United Nations Human Rights Council, director general for development cooperation and deputy ambassador to the U.N. In 2023, she became Korea’s first female ambassador to the Vatican. In June 2025, she was named third deputy director of the National Security Office, where she handled diplomatic and security issues related to economic and technology security. KOICA described Oh as a development cooperation expert with more than 30 years of experience in official development assistance, multilateral diplomacy and economic security. Official development assistance is aid that governments and public institutions give to support economic development and welfare in developing countries. “Based on the experience KOICA has built over the past 35 years, we will work closely with related ministries and agencies to leap forward as a unified KOICA that opens a new chapter in Korea’s development cooperation,” Oh said in her inaugural speech. She also pledged to support the participation and growth of partners such as young people and companies. She said KOICA would pursue development cooperation that balances the progress of partner countries with Korea’s national interests. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 前国家副安全顾问就任KOICA负责人
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 吴贤周此前曾任总统国家安全办公室副主任，是一位职业外交官。她于星期一就任韩国国际合作机构（KOICA）第15任总裁。该机构是韩国政府向发展中国家实施政府援助的主要机构，成立于1991年。当天，KOICA在位于京畿道城南市的总部举行了就职典礼。吴毕业于高丽大学西班牙语文学专业，并获剑桥大学国际关系硕士学位。她于1994年通过外交官考试后进入外交部，历任外交部发展合作司司长、驻日内瓦代表团参赞、联合国人权理事会主席特别顾问、发展合作总司长及联合国副大使等重要职务。2023年，她成为韩国首位出任梵蒂冈大使的女性。2025年6月，她获任国家安全办公室第三副主任，负责处理与经济安全和技术安全有关的外交及安全事务。KOICA称吴是一位发展合作专家，拥有30多年的官方发展援助、多边外交及经济安全工作经验。官方发展援助是指政府和公共机构为支持发展中国家的经济发展与福祉而提供的援助。吴在就职演说中表示：“我们将依托KOICA过去35年积累的经验，与相关部委和机构密切合作，作为团结统一的KOICA实现跃升，开启韩国发展合作的新篇章。”她还承诺支持年轻人和企业等伙伴方的参与与发展，并表示KOICA将推动兼顾伙伴国发展与韩国国家利益的发展合作。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/b.summary_zh: 随着牛津大学韩国研究中心成立新的出版品牌，演员车仁Pb有望成为首部借助该渠道出版的作品，从而让更多英语读者接触韩国文学。据韩联社报道，牛津韩国研究中心（OCKS）周一宣布，已与当地独立出版机构Oxford eBooks签署谅解备忘录，共同成立K-PRESS——一个专门将韩国文学翻译成英语的新出版品牌。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/b.body: Actor Cha In-pyo novel expected to be the 1st work to be published Korean literature is set to reach more English-speaking readers through a new publishing imprint established by Oxford University's Korean studies center. The Oxford Centre for Korean Studies (OCKS) said Monday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with a local independent publisher, Oxford eBooks, to establish K-PRESS — a new imprint dedicated to translating Korean literature into English, according to Yonhap News Agency. The first title to be published will be “Mother Star,” the English edition of actor and novelist Cha In-pyo's debut novel. Jieun Kiaer, director of the center, told Yonhap that barriers to translation and publication remain high, with English-language editions concentrated among a small number of Korean writers and genres. She expressed hope that K-PRESS would introduce a wider range of stories reflecting Korean lives, emotions, humor and imagination. K-PRESS also plans to participate in the Oxford Indie Book Fair at the university campus on Sunday. First held in 2020, the event brings together about 150 independent publishers and authors. The partnership seeks to address the gap between international enthusiasm for Korean culture and the limited selection of Korean books available in major British bookstores. Despite heightened interest following novelist Han Kang’s 2024 Nobel Prize win in literature, Korean children’s and young adult books remain particularly underrepresented overseas. The center will be tasked with identifying aspiring writers and works, while Oxford eBooks, which has operated locally for more than two decades, will handle publishing contracts, production, distribution and marketing. Oxford eBooks head Andy Severn told Yonhap the venture was worth the effort and risk, despite larger publishers’ reluctance to take chances on unfamiliar works. “Mother Star” was translated by Kiaer and British poet and writer Kate Clanchy. The novel addresses the suffering of victims of Japan’s wartime military sexual slavery during its colonial rule of Korea. First published in 2009, the book drew renewed attention in 2024 after being featured at Oxford’s inaugural Korean Literature Festival. Cha told Yonhap he welcomed a dedicated British publishing outlet for Korean literature and hoped English-speaking readers would empathize with the pain experienced by the victims
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/b.title_zh: 牛津本地出版社希望让英语读者读到更多韩国故事
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/b.body_zh: 随着牛津大学韩国研究中心成立新的出版品牌，韩国文学作品预计将成为首部面向英语读者推出的作品。韩国研究中心（OCKS）周一对韩联社表示，该中心已与当地独立出版商Oxford eBooks签署谅解备忘录，将成立K-PRESS——一个专门将韩国文学翻译成英语的新出版品牌。首部出版的图书将是演员兼小说家车仁彬的处女作小说《母星》的英文版。中心主任Jieun Kiaer对韩联社说，文学翻译和出版的门槛仍然很高，英语版作品主要集中在少数韩国作家和体裁。她希望K-PRESS能够介绍更多反映韩国人生活、情感、幽默和想象力的故事。K-PRESS还计划周日在大学校园内举行的牛津独立书展参展。该活动于2020年首次举办，汇集约150家独立出版商和作者。此次合作旨在缩小国际社会对韩国文化的热情与英国大型书店可售韩国图书种类有限之间的差距。尽管小说家韩江2024年诺贝尔文学奖获奖后，相关关注度有所提升，韩国儿童文学和青少年文学在海外仍明显偏少。中心将负责发掘有潜力的作家和作品，已在本地经营二十多年的Oxford eBooks则负责出版合同、制作、发行和营销。Oxford eBooks负责人Andy Severn对韩联社说，尽管大型出版商不愿在陌生作品上冒险，这一合作仍值得投入精力并承担风险。《母星》由Kiaer和英国诗人、作家Kate Clanchy共同翻译。小说讲述日本殖民统治朝鲜期间，遭受日本军队战时性奴役的受害者所承受的苦难。该书于2009年首次出版，2024年在牛津首届韩国文学节上受到推介后重新受到关注。车仁彬对韩联社表示，他欢迎英国设立专门出版韩国文学的出版机构，并希望英语读者能够体会受害者的痛苦……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary_zh: 李在明总统推动振兴科斯达克作为资本市场更广泛改革的一部分，但市场参与者在周一表示，他的方案缺乏吸引投资的具体措施。他们支持剔除经营疲弱的公司并拓宽投资者群体，但质疑迄今公布的措施能否带来持续资本流入。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: President Lee Jae Myung’s push to revive Kosdaq as part of broader capital market reforms is drawing skepticism, with market participants saying Monday that his proposals lack concrete measures to attract investment. They support removing weak companies and broadening the investor base but question whether the measures outlined so far will bring sustained capital inflows. At a policy meeting at the Korea Exchange on Friday, Lee acknowledged widespread concerns about Kosdaq and called for stricter enforcement of delisting rules to swiftly remove financially troubled or underperforming companies. The meeting followed steep declines in both KOSPI and Kosdaq from record highs earlier this year, fueling concerns about financial market stability. Na Seung-doo, an analyst at SK Securities, welcomed the emphasis on addressing the market’s structural weaknesses. However, he added, “The discussion offered little detail on how to make Kosdaq more attractive to major investors, leaving the timing of a meaningful policy catalyst even less clear.” The market’s recent gains also provide limited evidence of a lasting recovery in demand, according to Na. Kosdaq rose more than 9 percent last week, supported by institutional buying, after concerns about tighter regulations on artificial intelligence data centers following the U.S. midterm elections pushed it as low as the 629 level intraday. “The rebound may reflect a temporary shift in funds as investors sought to diversify their exposure while KOSPI struggled with the fallout from the Nvidia shock,” Na said. He stressed that attracting longer-term investment would require a benchmark that pension funds and other institutions could use to guide their allocations. He called for the swift introduction of the Kosdaq Select Index discussed at the meeting, followed by more exchange-traded funds and other investment products tracking it. In addition, he urged incentives for listed companies to improve investor engagement, saying many small and midcap firms with large controlling shareholder stakes remain reluctant to meet investors and analysts. Questions also remain over how the broader capital market reforms will be implemented. At the meeting, Lee ordered the creation of a task force involving the government, ruling and opposition parties, the exchange and other market participants to assess conditions and clarify points of contention. He asked for a designated senior official to report directly to him on its progress. Supporters see the body as a way to resolve competing interests and advance stalled legislation. Critics argue that with government-party consultations and parliamentary discussions already in place, another body could lengthen the decision-making process. Some members of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) are particularly concerned that the task force could overlap with the party’s existing special committee on capital market reform. They fear the committee’s work could lose momentum before the new body is launched and that it could subsequently lose control of the agenda. Securing opposition participation poses a further challenge. Efforts to bring opposition parties on board could hold up legislation, while their participation could still entail lengthy negotiations over disputed measures. “The president appeared to be seeking both faster reforms and broader procedural legitimacy, but whether the task force could deliver both is in doubt,” a DPK official said, asking not to be named

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 李在明总统推动重振科斯达克，作为更广泛资本市场改革的一部分，此举正引发质疑。市场参与者周一表示，他的方案缺乏吸引投资的具体措施。他们支持剔除弱势公司并扩大投资者群体，但质疑迄今公布的措施能否带来持续资本流入。周五在韩国交易所举行的一次政策会议上，李承认外界普遍对科斯达克存在担忧，并要求严格执行退市规则，迅速将财务困难或表现不佳的公司摘牌。此次会议召开前，科斯达克和综合指数自今年早些时候创下的历史高点均大幅下跌，引发了人们对金融市场稳定的担忧。SK证券分析师罗胜杜对解决市场结构性弊端的重视表示欢迎。不过，他补充道：“此次讨论几乎没有说明如何提高科斯达克对大型投资者的吸引力，因此 meaningful政策催化剂何时出现就更不明确了。”据罗胜杜称，该市场近期上涨也仅为需求持续复苏提供了有限证据。上周，在美国中期选举后，市场担忧将加强对人工智能数据中心的监管，科斯达克盘中一度跌至629点，随后在机构买盘推动下上涨逾9%。罗胜杜说：“在Nvidia冲击余波令综合指数陷入困境之际，这轮反弹可能反映投资者寻求分散风险敞口时带来的资金暂时轮动。”他强调，要吸引长期投资，需要一个基准，供养老金和其他机构配置资产时参考。他呼吁迅速推出会上讨论的科斯达克精选指数，随后推出更多跟踪该指数的交易所交易基金及其他投资产品。此外，他敦促为上市公司加强投资者互动提供激励，并表示，许多控股股东持股比例较高的小型和中盘公司仍不愿与投资者和分析师会面。更广泛资本市场改革将如何落实，也存在疑问。会议期间，李要求成立一个工作组，由政府、执政党、反对党、交易所及其他市场参与者共同参与，评估市场状况并厘清争议点。他要求指定一名高级官员就工作组进展直接向他汇报。支持者认为，该机构有助于协调相互冲突的利益并推动陷入停滞的立法。批评者则认为，政府与各党的磋商及议会讨论已经在进行，再设立一个机构可能延长决策过程。执政的韩国民主党部分成员尤其担心，新工作组会与该党现有的资本市场改革特别委员会职能重叠。他们担心，在新机构成立前，特别委员会的工作会失去动力，而此后又可能失去议程主导权。让反对党参与进来也是一项挑战。争取反对党加入可能拖延立法进程，而即使反对党参与，围绕争议措施仍可能进行旷日持久的谈判。一名韩国民主党官员表示：“总统似乎既想加快改革步伐，又想扩大程序合法性，但工作组能否兼顾两者仍存疑。”该官员要求不具名

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.summary_zh: 首尔繁华的延世大学城附近，有一座隐藏在半山腰的公园，步行仅需8分钟即可到达。该公园计划到2027年进行重大改造，打造成为首屈一指的夜间旅游地标。项目旨在利用八面山开阔的城市景观，打造一处专门的日落和夜景目的地，并将山顶公园与延世路沿线充满活力的商业和餐饮区直接连接起来，以带动夜间旅游和地方商业。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body: A hidden hilltop park tucked just an eight-minute walk from Seoul’s bustling Sinchon university district is set to undergo a major transformation into a premier night tourism landmark by 2027. Seodaemun District said Monday that Changcheon Neighborhood Park, commonly known by locals as Baramsan (Wind Mountain) due to its breezy elevated terrain, has been selected for the Seoul Metropolitan Government's 2026 Seoul Starlight Attraction Creation Project. The district plans to invest up to 1 billion won in municipal funding following final budget reviews, supported by 50 million won in district funds already secured for initial master planning. The project aims to leverage Baramsan's sweeping urban views to create a dedicated sunset and night-view destination, linking the hilltop park directly to the vibrant commercial and dining strip along Yonsei-ro to stimulate nighttime tourism and local commerce. Spanning 6,322 square meters atop the hill, Changcheon Neighborhood Park has historically remained relatively unknown to the broader public despite its proximity to the busy subway station. Under the new plan, the district will upgrade existing facilities — including an elevator, viewing deck and landmark windmill structure — while preserving the natural topography. The park's entrance stairs will feature water features and landscape lighting to guide visitors upward, while the existing observation deck will be expanded into a curved sunset viewing lounge. Additional upgrades include shaded resting areas named "Wind Forest Lounge," seasonal gardens around the windmill and reinforced safety infrastructure. A district survey conducted in September showed that visitors prioritized benches and rest areas (53.7 percent) while citing safety concerns as the top issue for nighttime visits (46.3 percent). In response, the district will install additional CCTV cameras, emergency bells and restrained landscape lighting designed to minimize light pollution. Seodaemun District intends to integrate the park with nearby restaurants, cafes and performance venues along Yonsei-ro, creating a seamless loop where visitors can enjoy evening city views before returning to local dining and cultural spots. Survey data indicated that 82.9 percent of respondents are willing to patronize nearby commercial establishments in connection with a visit to Baramsan. The district plans to tie the park's opening into local revitalization initiatives such as the Sinchon Pass and the Seoul Vacation Festival. Upon completion in 2027, the district aims to increase nighttime visitors by more than 50 percent compared to pre-project levels while achieving an 80 percent user satisfaction rate. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.title_zh: 首尔拟于2027年前将新川一处隐秘山顶改造成日落及夜景公园
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body_zh: 距离首尔繁华的新村大学区步行仅8分钟，一座隐藏在山坡上的公园计划到2027年进行重大改造，升级为 premier 夜间旅游地标。西大门区周一表示，因地势较高且风势充足，当地居民通常将长川邻里公园称为“Baramsan（风山）”；该公园已入选首尔市政府2026年“首尔星光景点创建项目”。区计划在完成最终预算审查后投入最多10亿韩元市政资金；用于初步总体规划的5000万韩元区级资金已经到位。项目将利用Baramsan开阔的城市景观，打造专门的日落和夜景目的地，把山顶公园与延世路沿线充满活力的商业和餐饮带直接连接起来，以带动夜间旅游和本地商业。长川邻里公园占地6322平方米，位于山顶，尽管毗邻繁忙地铁站，却一直相对不为人知。根据新计划，区政府将在保护自然地形的同时，升级现有设施，包括电梯、观景台和标志性风车结构。公园入口楼梯将设置水景和景观照明，引导游客上山；现有观景台将扩建为弧形日落观景休闲区。其他升级项目包括以“风之森林休闲区”命名的遮荫休息区、风车周围的季节性花园，以及加强后的安全基础设施。区级部门9月开展的调查显示，游客最看重长椅和休息区（53.7%），并将安全问题列为夜间到访的首要顾虑（46.3%）。对此，区政府将增设监控摄像头、紧急呼叫铃和低亮度景观照明，以尽量减少光污染。西大门区打算把公园与延世路附近的餐厅、咖啡馆和演出场所整合起来，打造一条顺畅的游览环线，让游客欣赏夜间城市景观后，再回到当地餐饮和文化场所消费。调查数据显示，82.9%的受访者愿意在游览Baramsan期间光顾附近的商业机构。区计划把公园开放与新村通行证、首尔休闲节等本地振兴举措结合起来。工程预计于2027年完工，届时区政府的目标是让夜间访客较项目实施前增加50%以上，同时实现80%的使用者满意度。本文在生成式人工智能协助下发布，由《韩国时报》编辑

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Namdaemun Market accessories and local food specialties are heading to smartphone screens as Seoul's Jung District is set to host a live commerce broadcast on Naver Shopping Live on Wednesday, connecting small business merchants with nationwide online shoppers. The district office announced that six merchants across five local commercial hubs — including Namdaemun Market, Jungbu Market, Shin Jungbu Market, Shin Jungang Market and Donghwa-dong Alley Shopping District — will participate in the day-long event. Four merchants will offer food items, including artisanal sesame and perilla oils from Donghwa-dong, dried seaweed from Jungbu Market, nuts and dried seafood from Shin Jungbu Market and traditional sweet puffed wheat snacks from Shin Jungang Market. Meanwhile, two vendors from Namdaemun Market will showcase fashion accessories. Running from 11 a.m. to 4:20 p.m., each store will host a dedicated 40-minute segment featuring professional show hosts. Merchants will interact directly with live viewers, answer questions and offer discounts, limited-time special prices and purchase-verification events. Jung District has long served as a commercial center encompassing massive wholesale markets, specialized districts and local shopping alleys. To help traditional merchants adapt to e-commerce, the district has operated live commerce broadcasts since 2023, accumulating 58 sessions and 1.78 million total views. Viewership surged last year, with average views per broadcast jumping more than fourfold compared to the previous year. This year's program also focused on practical merchant training, covering artificial intelligence promotional video production, social media marketing, product display and online mall onboarding. Wednesday's broadcast serves as a practical showcase for merchants to put those digital skills to work. "Jung District's traditional markets possess unique charm and highly competitive products," said Jung District Mayor Kim Gil-sung. "We will continue to firmly support our merchants in their new challenges so their long-standing competitiveness can shine online and translate into loyal customers and higher sales." https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Chemical and renewable energy materials giant OCI Holdings and its basic chemicals unit OCI have both earned overall A grades in Korea's latest corporate sustainability assessment, lifted by improvements in governance, environmental management and workplace safety.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 化工及可再生能源材料巨头OCI Holdings及其基础化学品部门OCI，在韩国最新企业可持续发展评估中均获得总体A级评价，得益于公司治理、环境管理和工作场所安全等方面的改善。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Chemical and renewable energy materials giant OCI Holdings and its basic chemicals unit OCI have both earned overall A grades in Korea's latest corporate sustainability assessment, lifted by improvements in governance, environmental management and workplace safety. The companies said Monday they received the ratings in the 2026 assessment conducted by the Korea Institute of Corporate Governance and Sustainability, which evaluates listed companies across environmental, social and governance categories using a seven-tier grading system. OCI Holdings improved its overall rating to A from B+ last year, driven largely by stronger governance practices. Its governance grade also rose to A from B+, reflecting efforts to strengthen board independence, internal auditing and corporate oversight. The company increased the proportion of independent directors on board committees from 80 percent to 100 percent, while placing its internal audit department directly under the audit committee and reinforcing its internal control framework. OCI, the group’s operating company, maintained its overall A grade for the second consecutive year, while improving its environmental rating to A from B+ and its social rating to A+ from A. Its environmental performance was recognized for showing recycled waste plastic oil consumption over the past three years and securing Zero Waste to Landfill certification for its Gunsan plant. In the social category, the company received higher marks for introducing a long-term occupational safety and health management roadmap and incorporating supply-chain environmental, social, and governance (ESG) policies into board-approved frameworks. OCI Holdings said its groupwide ESG Management Council, established in 2024, has played a central role in coordinating sustainability initiatives across affiliates. The company also maintained an A rating in MSCI’s 2025 ESG assessment for the third consecutive year and was included in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Korea index for the 17th straight year. “We will continue to strengthen the group’s ESG management capabilities and build greater market trust through sustainable management aligned with global standards,” the official said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: OCI Holdings和OCI在2026年ESG评估中均获评A级
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 化工及可再生能源材料巨头OCI Holdings及其基础化学业务部门OCI在韩国最新企业可持续性评估中均获得总体A级评级，得益于公司治理、环境管理和工作场所安全等方面的改善。两家公司周一表示，它们在韩国企业治理与可持续性研究院开展的2026年评估中获得了上述评级。该评估采用七级评级体系，从环境、社会和治理等类别对上市公司进行评价。OCI Holdings的总体评级由去年的B+提升至A，主要得益于公司治理实践的改善。其治理评级也由B+升至A，反映出公司在加强董事会独立性、内部审计和企业监督方面所作的努力。公司将董事会各委员会中独立董事的比例从80%提高至100%，同时将内部审计部门直接置于审计委员会之下，并强化内部控制框架。集团运营公司OCI连续第二年保持总体A级评级，同时将环境评级由B+提升至A，社会评级由A提升至A+。其环境表现因过去三年持续披露再生废塑料油消耗量，并为群山工厂取得“零废弃物填埋”认证而获得认可。在社会类别中，公司因制定长期职业安全与健康管理路线图，并将供应链环境、社会和治理（ESG）政策纳入经董事会批准的框架而获得更高评价。OCI Holdings表示，集团ESG管理委员会成立于2024年，在协调各关联公司的可持续发展举措方面发挥了核心作用。公司还在MSCI的2025年ESG评估中连续第三年保持A级评级，并连续第17年入选道琼斯韩国最佳管理类指数。该公司官员表示：“我们将继续加强集团的ESG管理能力，通过符合全球标准的可持续管理提升市场信任。”本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Ten teams of undergraduate and graduate students showcased six months of social innovation projects in Seoul last week, presenting solutions ranging from artificial intelligence tools that ease special education teachers' workloads to an app helping visually impaired pedestrians cross streets safely. Hosted by the Seoul Future Talent Foundation at its community center, the 2026 Seoul Impact Project showcase highlighted student-led initiatives tackling persistent social challenges.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 上周，10支由本科生和研究生组成的团队在首尔展示了历时6个月的社会创新项目成果，提出的解决方案涵盖减轻特殊教育教师工作负担的人工智能工具，以及帮助视障行人安全过街的应用程序。2026年首尔影响力项目展示活动由首尔未来人才基金会在其社区中心主办，聚焦学生主导、旨在应对长期社会挑战的创新举措。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Ten teams of undergraduate and graduate students showcased six months of social innovation projects in Seoul last week, presenting solutions ranging from artificial intelligence tools that ease special education teachers' workloads to an app helping visually impaired pedestrians cross streets safely. Hosted by the Seoul Future Talent Foundation at its community center, the 2026 Seoul Impact Project showcase highlighted student-led initiatives tackling persistent social challenges. After evaluating presentations, a judging panel awarded 15 million won ($10,800) in combined prize money to three standout teams. Aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, the program supports teams of two to five students creating public value. Selected through a three-stage screening process, each of the 10 teams received 5 million won in project funding and 2 million won per member in activity stipends, alongside specialized workshops. The team named Peering won the grand prize and 7 million won for building an AI workflow system for special education teachers. After identifying bottlenecks in classroom administration, the team created a digital platform to streamline paperwork and daily operations. "The Seoul Impact Project was a valuable opportunity for us to grow as a social venture and develop an impact-driven business," said Kim Yoon-jo of Peering. "We will continue growing into a startup that delivers real social value." The runner-up prize of 5 million won went to AlliLAB for an investigative journalism project examining the "fear of missing out" among young adults as a broader social issue. Eduality took third place and received 3 million won for developing an AI research assistant guiding high school students through academic inquiry reports with input from master's-level researchers and admissions experts. Other teams focused on accessibility, youth empowerment and community ties. SafeWalk released a free AI app recognizing pedestrian traffic signals for visually impaired users, Orot studied easy-to-read election materials and pictorial voting aids for people with developmental disabilities, and Surisurimasuri began developing a predictive maintenance system for powered mobility devices. LinkRights built a rights platform and mentorship program for migrant-background youths, Didimdol Economic Education TF created a welfare literacy platform for teens, Sumgyeol published an interview book for young family caregivers and Itda connected senior citizens who make homemade side dishes with young adults. "We will continue actively supporting young people so they can grow into innovative leaders driving lasting social change," said Nam Sung-wook, chairman of the Seoul Future Talent Foundation. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 学生展示人工智能工具以解决社会挑战
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 上周，10支由本科生和研究生组成的团队在首尔展示了为期六个月的社会创新项目成果，提出的解决方案涵盖减轻特殊教育教师工作负担的人工智能工具，以及帮助视障行人安全过街的应用程序。由首尔未来人才基金会主办、2026首尔影响力项目展示活动在其社区中心举行，重点呈现了由学生主导、旨在应对长期社会挑战的创新项目。评审团在观看展示后，向3支表现突出的团队颁发了合计1500万韩元（$10,800）的奖金。该项目与联合国可持续发展目标保持一致，支持由2至5名学生组成的团队创造公共价值。经过三阶段遴选，10支入选团队每支均获得500万韩元项目资金，以及每名成员200万韩元的活动津贴和专业工作坊。名为Peering的团队凭借为特殊教育教师开发的人工智能工作流系统，获得大奖和700万韩元奖金。该团队在识别出课堂管理中的瓶颈后，开发了一个数字平台，用于简化文书工作和日常运营。Peering团队的Kim Yoon-jo表示：“首尔影响力项目让我们有机会成长为一家社会创新企业，并开发一家以影响力为导向的企业，这对我们而言十分宝贵。我们将继续成长为一家创造真实社会价值的初创企业。”亚军奖由AlliLAB获得，奖金为500万韩元；该团队开展了一项调查新闻项目，将年轻人中普遍存在的“错失恐惧感”作为更广泛的社会议题进行分析。Eduality获得第三名和300万韩元奖金；该团队开发了一款人工智能研究助手，在硕士级研究人员和招生专家的参与下，指导高中生完成学术研究报告。其他团队则聚焦于无障碍服务、青年赋权和社区联系。SafeWalk发布了一款免费人工智能应用，可为视障用户识别行人交通信号灯；Orot研究了便于残障人士阅读的选举材料，以及为发育障碍人士提供的图示投票辅助工具；Surisurimasuri开始开发电动助行设备的预测性维护系统。LinkRights为具有移民背景的青年搭建了权益保障平台和导师辅导项目；Didimdol Economic Education TF创建了面向青少年的福利素养平台；Sumgyeol出版了一本面向年轻家庭照护者的访谈集；Itda则将制作自制副菜的老年人与年轻人连接起来。首尔未来人才基金会主席Nam Sung-wook表示：“我们将继续积极支持年轻人，使他们成长为推动持久社会变革的创新型领袖。”本文在生成式人工智能的协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: SK Telecom, Hyosung team up to build AI data center power infrastructure
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Manufacturing key equipment without delay is shared goal SK Telecom signed a strategic partnership agreement with Hyosung Heavy Industries to secure power equipment and explore new technologies for gigawatt-scale artificial intelligence (AI) data centers, the telecom company said Monday. The partnership combines SK Telecom's experience in developing and operating AI data centers with Hyosung Heavy Industries' power equipment manufacturing and engineering capabilities.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 及时制造关键设备是共同目标 SK Telecom周一表示，已与晓星重工签署战略合作协议，以确保电力设备供应，并探索面向吉瓦级人工智能（AI）数据中心的新技术。该协议将SK Telecom在开发和运营AI数据中心方面的经验，与晓星重工的电力设备制造和工程能力结合起来。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Manufacturing key equipment without delay is shared goal SK Telecom signed a strategic partnership agreement with Hyosung Heavy Industries to secure power equipment and explore new technologies for gigawatt-scale artificial intelligence (AI) data centers, the telecom company said Monday. The memorandum of understanding covers equipment supplies for 345-kilovolt substations, joint testing of next-generation power technologies and potential cooperation in developing and building new AI data centers. SK Telecom CEO Jung Jai-hun and Hyosung Heavy Industries CEO Woo Tae-hee signed the agreement at SK Telecom's headquarters in central Seoul. Their discussions also covered various business cooperation opportunities involving AI power infrastructure. The partnership combines SK Telecom's experience in developing and operating AI data centers with Hyosung Heavy Industries' power equipment manufacturing and engineering capabilities. The companies aim to address the large, concentrated electricity demand of AI facilities by securing essential equipment and strengthening operational reliability. Their first priority is establishing a stable supply system for key power equipment, including components for 345-kilovolt substations. These facilities receive electricity from the grid and convert it to voltages suitable for data centers. The companies will discuss production and delivery schedules in advance for equipment such as transformers, which can take a long time to manufacture and deliver. Delays in securing such equipment can push back installation and startup schedules, SK Telecom said. They will also jointly assess and test technologies including 800-volt direct-current power distribution. This approach delivers direct current closer to servers and telecommunications equipment, reducing the number of power conversion stages. The companies said the work would help lay the technological groundwork for improving energy efficiency at future AI data centers, while ensuring timely equipment procurement. Cooperation will extend to operations after the facilities open. The partners plan to share expertise in operating and maintaining extra-high-voltage substation equipment to improve the stability and reliability of electricity supplies. They will also explore opportunities to develop and build new data centers, as well as joint business models drawing on their respective capabilities. “The partnership will provide a basis for securing essential power infrastructure and expanding cooperation into large-scale AI data center development and construction,” Jung said. “Combining Hyosung Heavy Industries' power technologies with SK Telecom's data center operating experience would help establish a stable electricity supply base," Woo said. "The partnership would expand over the long term beyond SK Telecom to the wider SK Group, creating further opportunities in the AI data center power market.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: SK Telecom与晓星携手建设人工智能数据中心电力基础设施
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 及时制造关键设备是双方共同目标。SK Telecom周一表示，已与Hyosung Heavy Industries签署战略合作协议，以确保电力设备供应，并探索面向吉瓦级人工智能（AI）数据中心的新技术。该谅解备忘录涵盖345千伏变电站的设备供应、下一代电力技术的联合测试，以及在开发和建设新AI数据中心方面的潜在合作。SK Telecom首席执行官郑在勋与Hyosung Heavy Industries首席执行官禹泰熙在首尔市中心的SK Telecom总部签署了协议。双方讨论还涉及与AI电力基础设施有关的多种业务合作机会。此次合作将SK Telecom开发和运营AI数据中心的经验，与Hyosung Heavy Industries的电力设备制造和工程能力结合起来。双方旨在通过确保关键设备供应和加强运营可靠性，应对AI设施规模大且集中的用电需求。合作的首要任务是建立关键电力设备的稳定供应体系，包括345千伏变电站的相关部件。这些设施从电网接收电力，并将其转换为适合数据中心的电压。对于变压器等制造和交付耗时较长的设备，双方将提前讨论生产和交付计划。SK Telecom表示，延迟确保此类设备可能推迟安装和启用进度。双方还将联合评估和测试包括800伏直流配电在内的技术。这种方式将直流电输送到更靠近服务器和电信设备的位置，从而减少电力转换环节。两家公司表示，相关工作将为未来AI数据中心提升能源效率奠定技术基础，同时确保及时采购设备。合作还将延伸至设施投运后的运营环节。合作伙伴计划共享超高压变电站设备运营和维护方面的专业知识，提高供电的稳定性与可靠性。双方还将探索开发和建设新数据中心的机会，以及利用各自能力打造联合商业模式。郑在勋表示：“此次合作将为确保关键电力基础设施奠定基础，并将合作拓展至大规模AI数据中心的开发和建设。将Hyosung Heavy Industries的电力技术与SK Telecom的数据中心运营经验相结合，有助于建立稳定的供电基础。”禹泰熙表示：“随着时间推移，合作将超越SK Telecom并扩展至更广泛的SK集团，在AI数据中心电力市场创造更多机会。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: PM pledges to bring home remains of every single independence fighter from overseas
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook renewed the government's commitment Monday to bringing the remains of independence fighters back home from overseas as she marked the return of the remains of two patriots who fought for Korea's independence from Japan's 1910-45 colonial rule. The remains of Ho Si-han and Lee Gwal arrived Sunday from the United States and Uzbekistan, respectively, and the government held an official ceremony at Seodaemun Independence Park in central Seoul on Monday to commemorate their return.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩美 HAN Seong-sook 总理周一重申政府承诺，将海外独立运动人士的遗骸迎回祖国，以纪念两名为韩国摆脱日本1910年至1945年殖民统治而斗争的爱国人士遗骸归国。Ho Si-han和Lee Gwal的遗骸于周日分别从美国和乌兹别克斯坦运抵，政府周一在首尔市中心的西大门独立公园举行正式仪式，纪念他们归国。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook renewed the government's commitment Monday to bringing the remains of independence fighters back home from overseas as she marked the return of the remains of two patriots who fought for Korea's independence from Japan's 1910-45 colonial rule. The remains of Ho Si-han and Lee Gwal arrived Sunday from the United States and Uzbekistan, respectively, and the government held an official ceremony at Seodaemun Independence Park in central Seoul on Monday to commemorate their return. The remains will be buried at the national cemetery in the central city of Daejeon. "I offer my infinite respect to the two patriots who, with indomitable courage and spirit, forged ahead through a treacherous, thorn-strewn path for the sake of our nation's independence," Han said. "The government will uphold the noble spirit of patriotic martyrs, with a firm commitment never to forget a single hero." She also expressed gratitude to the governments of the United States and Uzbekistan. "Honoring the noble sacrifices and great patriotic spirit of our forebears with the utmost respect is a fundamental duty of the nation and a precious legacy to be passed on to future generations," Han said. "We will do our utmost to bring home every single one of the independence fighters who passed away in faraway foreign lands," she said. Ho, born in Seoul in 1885, was arrested by the Japanese police while raising military funds following the March 1 independence movement against Japan's colonial rule of Korea. He also took part in a number of fundraising efforts to support the Korean independence movement from 1927 to 1945 before he died in Los Angeles in 1956. The South Korean government posthumously awarded him the Aejok Order of Merit for National Foundation in 2021 for his role in the country's independence. Lee, born in North Hamgyong Province in 1898, moved to Manchuria and actively participated in Korean national organizations in Russia's far eastern region of Primorsky Krai in 1919. He also served as the diplomatic delegate of the Korean provisional government in the early 1920s, but he was later deported to Uzbekistan in 1937, where he died. Lee was awarded the National Foundation Medal in 2009
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 总理承诺将每一位海外独立斗争者的遗骸迎回祖国
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国总统韩昇洙星期一重申政府承诺，将海外独立运动者的遗骸迎回祖国，以纪念两名为韩国摆脱日本1910年至1945年殖民统治而奋斗的爱国者遗骸归国 respectively。何时韩和李克权的遗骸于星期日分别从美国和乌兹别克斯坦运抵，政府星期一在首尔市中心的西大门独立公园举行正式仪式，纪念他们归国。遗骸将安葬在大田市中心的国家公墓。韩说：“我向这两位爱国者致以无限敬意，他们以不屈的勇气和精神，为我们国家的独立铺平了一条充满险阻、荆棘丛生的道路。”她说：“政府将秉承爱国烈士的高尚精神，以坚定的承诺绝不遗忘每一位英雄。”她还向美国和乌兹别克斯坦政府致谢。韩说：“以最大的敬意铭记先辈的高尚牺牲和伟大爱国精神，是国家的基本职责，也是传递给后世的宝贵遗产。”她说：“我们将尽最大努力，把每一位在遥远异国去世的独立运动者的遗骸全部迎回祖国。”何时韩1885年出生于首尔，在3月1日独立运动反对日本殖民统治韩国期间为筹集军事资金而被日本警察逮捕。他还在1927年至1945年间多次参与支持韩国独立运动的筹款活动，之后于1956年在洛杉矶去世。韩国政府于2021年追授他国家基础功勋爱菊勋章，以表彰其对国家独立的贡献。李克权1898年出生于咸镜北道，1919年迁往满洲，并积极参与俄罗斯远东滨海边疆地区的韩国人组织。他还在20世纪20年代初担任韩国临时政府外交代表，后来于1937年被驱逐至乌兹别克斯坦，并在那里去世。李克权于2009年获授国家基础勋章

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Honoring a bygone Korean industrialist
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: A posthumous award presented to a renowned Korean industrialist who passed away two years ago was a notable highlight of a recent ceremony. His entrepreneurial spirit, rational approach and unwavering dedication throughout his life made him an exemplary figure in Korean industrial history. The late industrialist left behind a wealth of valuable lessons and an enduring legacy, not only for Korea but also for its numerous international business and investment partners.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 在最近举行的一场颁奖仪式上，颁给一位两年前去世的著名韩国企业家的追授奖项成为一大亮点。他终生的创业精神、理性态度和坚定奉献，使他成为韩国工业史上的典范人物。这位已故企业家留下了宝贵的经验财富和持久传承，不仅对韩国如此，也惠及韩国众多国际商业和投资伙伴。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: A posthumous award presented to a renowned Korean industrialist who passed away two years ago was a notable highlight of a recent ceremony. The honor was bestowed at the Grand Walkerhill Seoul on Nov. 6. The event, attended by approximately 300 military personnel and civilians, including the newly appointed U.S. Ambassador to Korea Michelle Park Steel and her husband, was held as part of the 24th Korea-America Friendship Night, an annual gathering organized by the Korea-America Association (KAA), headed by Choi Joong-kyung. Following careful deliberation, the KAA's citation committee selected Cho Suck-rai (1935–2024), former honorary chairman of Hyosung Group, as this year's recipient. Cho studied applied chemistry at Waseda University in Japan before earning a master's degree in chemical engineering from the Illinois Institute of Technology in the United States. He married Song Kwang-ja in 1967, and together they raised three accomplished sons. As the eldest son of Hyosung Group founder Cho Hong-jae, he joined the company 60 years ago on Nov. 3, 1966. He served as its chairman for 35 years, from 1982 to 2017. Under his determined and visionary leadership, Hyosung developed into a global powerhouse in textiles, chemicals and advanced technologies. He established Korea's first privately operated corporate technology research laboratory, demonstrating his strong commitment to innovation. His efforts helped bring international recognition to a range of products and businesses, including Creora spandex, tire cords, chemicals, construction and power transformers. His outstanding achievements in laying a solid foundation for closer cooperation between Korea and the United States through his contributions to diverse industrial sectors deserve the highest recognition. His entrepreneurial spirit, rational approach and unwavering dedication throughout his life made him an exemplary figure in Korean industrial history. Beyond the business world, Cho was also highly respected for his contributions to civilian diplomacy. He worked tirelessly to strengthen Korea's relations with the United States and Japan, while promoting the country's standing in the international business community. His legacy lives on through Hyosung's business ventures in Memphis, Tennessee, as well as its world-class expertise in high-voltage direct current technology. The award carried special significance because Cho's father-in-law, the late Song In-sang, received the same honor in 2004. Song served as finance minister under President Syngman Rhee and was the longest-serving chairman and president of the KAA, holding the position for 21 years. It was an unusual and remarkable occasion for both a father-in-law and his son-in-law to be honored for their respective contributions to Korea-U.S. friendship. At the conclusion of the award ceremony, Cho's wife and two of his sons, accompanied by approximately 20 senior executives from Hyosung Group, accepted the posthumous recognition. The late industrialist left behind a wealth of valuable lessons and an enduring legacy, not only for Korea but also for its numerous international business and investment partners. Cho's distinguished achievements remind us that a person's lifelong dedication, relentless pursuit of challenges and outstanding accomplishments can shine forever, even after that individual has departed this world. His remarkable legacy will continue to inspire future generations of Korean business leaders and those committed to strengthening international friendship and cooperation. Lee Sun-ho (wkexim@naver.com) is a freelance columnist based in Seoul. He has been writing since 1967
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 致敬一位已故韩国实业家
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 最近举行的一场颁奖典礼上，向两年前去世的著名韩国企业家追授的奖项成为一大亮点。该奖项于11月6日在首尔大华山庄（Grand Walkerhill Seoul）颁发。约有300名军方人员和 civilians 出席活动，其中包括新任美国驻韩大使朴 steel? 以及她的丈夫；活动是第24届韩美友谊之夜的一部分。这项年度聚会由韩美协会（KAA）主办，协会由崔重卿（Choi Joong-kyung）担任负责人。经过审慎审议，韩美协会颁奖委员会选定晓胜来（Cho Suck-rai，1935—2024）为本年度获奖者。他曾任晓星集团名誉会长。早年，晓胜来在日本早稻田大学学习应用化学，随后在美国伊利诺伊理工学院取得化学工程硕士学位。他于1967年与宋光子结婚，两人共同培养了三个成才的儿子。作为晓星集团创始人晓洪宰的长子，他于1966年11月3日，即60年前加入公司。1982年至2017年间，他担任公司董事长达35年。在他的坚定且富有远见的领导下，晓星发展成为纺织、化工和先进技术领域的全球劲旅。他创办了韩国第一家私营公司技术研究实验室，展现了对创新的坚定投入。他的努力帮助包括Creora氨纶、轮胎帘子线、化工产品、建筑及电力变压器在内的众多产品和业务获得国际认可。他通过向多个工业领域作出的贡献，为韩美两国建立更紧密的合作关系奠定了坚实基础，其卓越成就理应获得最高表彰。他一生的创业精神、理性态度和不懈奉献，使其成为韩国工业史上的典范人物。在商业世界之外，晓胜来在民间外交方面也备受尊重。他不懈努力加强韩国与美国、日本的关系，同时提升韩国在国际商业界的地位。他的精神遗产通过晓星集团在田纳西州孟菲斯的业务，以及该集团在高压直流技术方面的世界级专长延续下来。这项奖项具有特殊意义，因为晓胜来的岳父、已故宋仁相于2004年也获得了同一奖项。宋仁相曾在李承晚总统担任韩国财政部长，并担任韩美协会主席兼会长长达21年，是该协会任期最长的主席兼会长。岳父与女婿分别因对韩美友谊作出贡献而受到表彰，是一场非同寻常且意义非凡的活动。颁奖典礼结束时，晓胜来的妻子和两个儿子在晓星集团约20名高级管理人员陪同下，接受了这项追授表彰。这位已故企业家留下了宝贵经验和持久精神遗产，不仅惠及韩国，也惠及韩国众多国际商业和投资伙伴。晓胜来的卓越成就提醒我们，一个人的毕生奉献、对挑战的不懈追求以及卓越成就在其离世之后仍可永远闪耀。他非凡的精神遗产将继续激励未来的韩国商业领袖，以及致力于加强国际友谊与合作的人们。李善浩（wkexim@naver.com）是驻首尔的自由撰稿人，自1967年起开始写作。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Major crimes unit's Seoul office raids restaurant franchisor in 1st search operation
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The Seoul Regional Office of the Serious Crime Investigation Agency (SCIA) raided the restaurant franchisor Myeong Ryun Dang Co. on Monday over allegations of unfair affiliate support, marking its first search and seizure operation since its establishment last month.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 严重犯罪调查局（SCIA）首尔 regional office 周一突袭餐厅加盟商 Myeong Ryun Dang Co.，原因是该公司涉嫌不公平地向关联公司提供支持。这是该机构上月成立以来首次开展搜查和扣押行动。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Seoul Regional Office of the Serious Crime Investigation Agency (SCIA) raided the restaurant franchisor Myeong Ryun Dang Co. on Monday over allegations of unfair affiliate support, marking its first search and seizure operation since its establishment last month. SCIA investigators began searching 26 locations, including the company's headquarters in Seoul's southern district of Songpa and the residence of company Chairman Lee Jong-geun, at around 9 a.m. Lee's lending companies are suspected of having reaped 21.7 billion won in unfair profits by lending the funds to Myeongryun Jinsa Galbi franchisees at interest rates ranging from 12 percent to 18 percent, according to an estimate by the Fair Trade Commission (FTC). The FTC filed a complaint against Myeong Ryun Dang and Lee in September over alleged violations of the fair trade law. The FTC suspects that the funds Myeong Ryun Dang lent to Lee's lending companies included 79 billion won in policy loans obtained from the state-run Korea Development Bank at annual interest rates of 3 to 4 percent. The SCIA was launched Oct. 2 as part of a criminal justice overhaul stripping prosecutors of their independent investigative powers. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary_zh: 韩国反垄断监管机构周一表示，已就涉嫌不公平行为启动同意裁决程序，涉及两家指定代驾服务提供商和两家司机调度软件运营商，其中包括通过司机评级制度实质上强加销售指标。美国联邦贸易委员会表示，这四家公司已申请达成同意裁决；根据该程序，案件可通过自愿采取纠正措施结案，而无需认定是否违反法律。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body: Korea's antitrust watchdog said Monday it has initiated a consent resolution process involving two designated driver service providers and two driver dispatch software operators over alleged unfair practices, including effectively imposing sales targets through a driver rating system. The Fair Trade Commission's (FTC) move concerns Kakao Mobility Corp. and T Map Mobility Co., affiliated with Kakao Corp. and SK Group, respectively, as well as driver dispatch software operators CMNP and YLP, over suspected violations of the Fair Trade Act. Kakao Mobility sold its entire stake in CMNP late last year but maintains a business partnership with the company, while YLP is wholly owned by T Map Mobility. They also allegedly used a driver rating system to effectively impose sales targets, according to the watchdog. The FTC said the four companies have applied for a consent resolution, under which a case is closed through voluntary corrective measures without a determination of whether the law was violated. Kakao Mobility proposed allowing drivers to use their individual insurance coverage and passing on the resulting savings in group insurance premiums to drivers as payments for each trip. The Kakao affiliate also pledged to abolish the driver rating system and ease dispatch restrictions imposed on drivers for canceling assigned trips. Other measures included a commitment of 1.51 billion won ($1.13 million) to support drivers, along with 1.26 billion won to improve their safety. T Map Mobility proposed similar measures, including selling insurance products and additional features separately, and lowering prices. The FTC said it decided to initiate the consent resolution process after considering the proposed measures' effectiveness in improving business practices in the designated driver service market and protecting drivers' rights. The watchdog added it will also assess whether the proposed corrective measures are commensurate with the sanctions that could be imposed. The FTC plans to discuss the proposed measures in detail with the four companies to draw up a provisional consent resolution, which will be finalized after gathering feedback from relevant agencies
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.title_zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会就代驾服务提供商启动同意裁决程序
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body_zh: 韩国反垄断监管机构周一表示，已就涉嫌不公平行为启动同意处分程序，涉及两家指定叫车服务运营商和两家司机派单软件运营商。这些行为包括通过司机评分系统实质性强加销售指标。韩国公平交易委员会（Fair Trade Commission，FTC）的行动涉及 Kakao Mobility Corp. 和 T Map Mobility Co.，两家公司分别隶属于 Kakao Corp. 和 SK Group，同时还涉及司机派单软件运营商 CMNP 和 YLP，原因是涉嫌违反《公平交易法》。Kakao Mobility 于去年年底出售了所持 CMNP 的全部股份，但仍与该公司保持业务合作关系；YLP 则由 T Map Mobility 全资拥有。据该监管机构称，这些公司还涉嫌利用司机评分系统实质性强加销售指标。FTC 表示，这四家公司已申请同意处分。根据该程序，案件将通过自愿采取纠正措施予以结案，而无需认定是否违法。Kakao Mobility 提议允许司机使用个人保险，并将团体保险保费因此节省的部分作为每次行程的报酬转交给司机。这家 Kakao 关联公司还承诺废除司机评分系统，并放宽因司机取消已分配行程而对其施加的派单限制。其他措施包括承诺提供 1.51 billion won（$1.13 million）用于支持司机，并投入 1.26 billion won 改善司机安全。T Map Mobility 提议采取类似措施，包括单独销售保险产品和其他附加功能，以及降低价格。FTC 表示，在评估所提措施能否有效改善指定叫车服务市场的经营行为并保护司机权益后，决定启动同意处分程序。该监管机构补充说，还将评估拟议的纠正措施是否与可能施加的处罚相称。FTC 计划与这四家公司详细讨论拟议措施，以拟定一份临时同意处分方案；该方案将在征求相关机构意见后最终敲定

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.body_zh: （昌原＝韩联社）记者朴英民报道：韩华海洋承包商工人16日进入绝食斗争，要求原承包商就工资、就业、福利等事项进行谈判，并敦促政府解决事态。金属工会巨济统营高城造船承包商支会和Wellive支会参与的“为原承包商谈判胜利而成立的共同斗争委员会”（公투위）当日上午在庆尚南道政府大楼新闻中心举行记者会，并公布了上述消息。造船承包商支会吸收了韩华海洋等当地造船厂承包商的工人，Wellive支会则吸收了韩华海洋内部餐饮、通勤巴士、设施管理等外包企业的工人。造船承包商支会会长姜仁锡在进入高工农场的涂装厂屋顶抗议现场展开第48天绝食；Wellive支会副会长姜奉宰和会长李形柱则在公司帐篷抗议现场绝食。公투위解释称，公투위上月8日起已与资方举行六轮原承包商谈判，但各方未能就谈判议题缩小分歧。公투위转述称，资方表示只能就安全相关的6个议题进行谈判，无法就工会要求的工资、就业、福利、工会活动等议题展开谈判。公투위表示：“正如高工斗争并非终点而只是开始，绝食斗争也不会是终点，而只是开始。”并称：“如果韩华海洋无视这一警告，我们还将发动共同罢工斗争等另一种斗争。”当天的记者会上通过电话参加会议的姜会长表示：“政府也曾承诺构建尊重劳动者的社会，韩华集团也高喊与承包商共存共荣。”他要求说：“政府应当兑现承诺，韩华集团应当作为雇主承担责任。”他随后强调：“劳动安全是谈判的出发点，不应成为阻碍劳动者权利的因素。”并补充道：“我们抱着这样的想法参加绝食斗争：如果不作出改变，大韩民国全体承包商和非正规劳动者的生活将无法得到任何改变。”请通过KakaoTalk的okjebo联系。〈版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再分发及用于人工智能学习和应用〉2026年11月16日14时59分发稿

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 박재하 기자 = 국회 법제사법위원회는 16일 대법관 격려금 3억2천400만원이 감액 등의 내용이 담긴 내년도 예산안을 여당 주도로 통과시켰다. 대법원의 경우 청소시설 공무직근로자의 처우개선을 위해 28억2천740만원을 증액하고, 대법관 격려금 3억2천400만원을 감액해 총 120억3천만원을 순증 의결했다. 앞서 감사원은 대법관 격려금과 관련해 법령상 근거 없는 정기 지급이 부적정하다고 보고 주의를 요구한 바 있다. 법무부는 형사소송법 개정 후속 조치를 위한 형사사법정보시스템(KICS) 기능개선 예산으로 총 140억7천500만원을 증액하고 신설되는 친일반민족행위자 재산조사위원회의 인건비와 운영비로 총 99억8천800만원을 반영하는 등 총 783억4천500만원을 증액하기로 했다. 고위공직자범죄수사처 소관 예산안은 형사소송법 개정 후속 조치를 위한 KICS 기능개선예산 27억2천900만원이 추가됐다. 이날 법사위에서는 더불어민주당 등 범여권을 주도로 한덕수 전 국무총리의 대법원 선고에 대한 긴급 현안질의가 열리기도 했다. 범여권 의원들은 한 전 총리의 선고 기일이 구속 만료 하루 전인 오는 19일에 열리는 데 대해 사법부를 향해 "내란 청산을 확실히 해달라"고 한목소리로 당부했다. 민주당 박균택 의원은 "조희대 대법원장이 설령 (한 전 총리를) 풀어줄 계획이 없었다고 해도 이런 국민적인 혼선이 초래된 것은 조 대법원장과 사법부에 대한 신뢰가 떨어져 있기 때문"이라며 "사법부 신뢰나 후배 법관들의 명예를 생각한다면 사퇴하는 것이 맞다"고 주장했다. 박형수 간사를 비롯한 국민의힘 법사위원들은 긴급 브리핑을 열고 "법원이 판단할 일에 대해 국회에서 일일이 따져 묻겠다는 것은 삼권분립 원칙을 완전히 무시한 참으로 오만하고 위험천만한 발상"이라고 비판했다. 이어 "거대 여당의 힘으로 삼권 분립 원칙을 훼손하고 재판에 노골적으로 개입하는 일체 시도를 즉각 중단하라"고 요구했다. 한편 이날 전체회의에 상정된 법안 중 국민건강보험공단에 특별사법경찰 권한을 부여하는 '사법경찰관리의 직무를 수행할 자와 그 직무 범위에 관한 법률' 개정안은 추가 논의를 거치기로 했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/16 14:59 송고 2026년11월16일 14시59분 송고 (서울=연합뉴스) 배재만 기자 = 16일 국회에서 열린 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의가 국민의힘 위원들이 불참한 가운데 열리고 있다. 2026.11.16 scoop@yna.co.kr
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.title_zh: 法曹委审议通过大幅削减3.2亿韩元“首席法官激励金”的预算修正案
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者朴在夏报道：国会法制司法委员会16日以执政党主导通过了包含削减大法官激励金等内容的明年预算案。最高法院方面为改善清洁设施公务人员的待遇，追加预算28亿2740万韩元，同时削减大法官激励金3亿2400万韩元，净增额最终确定为120亿3000万韩元。此前，审计部门曾认为大法官激励金缺乏法律依据，其定期发放不当，并提出要求予以关注。法务部为完善《刑事诉讼法》修订后的后续措施，追加用于刑事司法信息系统（KICS）功能改进的预算，总额增至140亿7500万韩元；还为新设的亲日民族行为者财产调查委员会拨列人员费和运营费，总额99亿8800万韩元等，共计追加预算783亿4500万韩元。高层公职者犯罪调查处管辖预算案中，新增用于完善KICS功能的27亿2900万韩元预算，以配合《刑事诉讼法》修订后的后续措施。当天，法制司法委员会还以执政党等在野党议员为主导，就前国务总理韩德洙受最高法院判决一事举行紧急质询。在野党议员就韩前总理宣判日期定于拘押期限届满前一日，即19日举行一事，异口同声敦促法务部“彻底清算内乱”。民主党议员朴균택表示：“即使最高法院大法官长赵基大原本没有打算释放韩前总理，如今造成如此全民性的混乱，也说明公众对赵大法官长和法务部的信任已经不足。如果考虑法务部的信誉和后辈法官的名誉，理应辞职。”以秘书朴亨秀等国民力量党法制委员在内的议员举行紧急记者会，批评称：“对于法院应当自行判断的事项，国会要逐一追究并质问，这是傲慢且极其危险的举动，完全无视了三权分立原则。”他们进一步要求：“立即停止一切利用庞大执政党力量破坏三权分立原则、公然干预审判的行为。”另一方面，当天提交全体会议审议的法案中，包括赋予国民健康保险公团特别司法警察权限的《关于执行司法警察管理职务的人员及其职务范围的法律》修正案，将在进行追加讨论后作出处理。如有报道，请联系KakaoTalk okjebo＜版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载・再发布，禁止用于AI学习及使用＞2026/11/16 14:59发布 2026年11月16日14时59分发布 （首尔＝韩联社）记者裴在满报道：16日，在国会举行的法制司法委员会全体会议正在召开，国民力量党议员缺席。2026.11.16 scoop@yna.co.kr

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 강수지 기자 = 한국신용평가는 최근 공정거래위원회의 국고채 입찰 담합 제재에 따른 과징금이 금융기관의 단기 수익성을 떨어뜨리겠지만, 자본 적정성에 미치는 직접적인 영향은 제한적일 것이라고 16일 내다봤다. 공정위는 지난 11일 국고채전문딜러(PD) 증권사 10곳과 은행 5곳 등 15개 금융기관이 약 3년 6개월 동안 국고채 경쟁입찰에서 투찰금리·물량을 합의하거나 정보를 교환했다며 단일 사건 역대 최대인 1조6천억원의 과징금을 부과했다. 증권사별로는 KB증권 3천322억원, NH투자증권 2천428억원, 미래에셋증권 2천148억원, 신한투자증권 1천473억원, 대신증권 1천201억원, 삼성증권 1천189억원 순이다. 은행 중에서는 IBK기업은행이 1천358억원으로 가장 많다. 한신평은 KB증권이 3분기 잠정실적 공시에서 과징금 전액을 충당부채로 계상한 점에 주목했다. 충당부채란 지출 시기와 금액이 불확실하지만, 미래 부담이 예상되는 비용을 부채로 쌓아두는 것을 말한다. 이에 다른 금융기관도 3분기나 4분기에 관련 비용을 인식할 가능성이 크며, 과징금 규모가 큰 곳을 중심으로 올해 수익성이 상당폭 저하될 수 있다고 내다봤다. 다만, 과징금이 금융기관별 자기자본의 4.2% 이하 수준이어서 자본 적정성에 미치는 영향은 대체로 제한적이라고 판단했다. 주요 증권사가 상대적으로 우수한 자본력을 갖췄고 상반기 양호한 실적으로 이익 완충력도 확보했다는 설명이다. 제재 대상 기관이 이의신청이나 취소소송에 나설 가능성도 있지만, 취소소송만으로 납부가 정지되지는 않아 집행정지가 받아들여지지 않으면 소송 중에도 납부가 먼저 이뤄질 수 있다고 설명했다. 한신평 윤소정 수석연구원은 "향후 이러한 재무 부담이 개별 업체의 이익창출력과 자본 적정성에 미치는 영향을 지속 점검해 신용평가에 반영할 것"이라며 "특히 증권업의 경우 하반기 영업환경이 비우호적으로 변화하고 있어 과징금 관련 비용이 인식될 경우 수익성 저하 압력이 가중될 수 있다"고 지적했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/16 14:58 송고 2026년11월16일 14시58분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.title_zh: “国债联手操纵罚金拖累证券公司盈利能力……对资本的影响有限”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者姜洙知报道，韩国信用评价公司于16日预计，公平交易委员会针对国债招标串通采取制裁措施后，相关罚款虽然会削弱金融机构的短期盈利能力，但对资本充足率的直接影响有限。公平交易委员会表示，该委员会于11日对韩国国债专业交易商（PD）中的10家券商、5家银行等15家金融机构处以1.6万亿韩元罚款，为单一案件史上最高罚款；这些机构在约3年6个月期间，在国债竞争性投标中串通投标利率和投标数量，或交换相关信息。按券商划分，罚款金额依次为KB证券3322亿韩元、NH投资证券2428亿韩元、未来资产证券2148亿韩元、新韩投资证券1473亿韩元、大信证券1201亿韩元、三星证券1189亿韩元。银行中，IBK企业银行罚款最高，为1358亿韩元。韩国信用评价公司注意到，KB证券在第三季度暂定业绩公告中已将全部罚款计为预计负债。韩国信用评价公司预计，其他金融机构也很可能在第三季度或第四季度确认相关费用，其中罚款规模较大的机构盈利能力今年可能出现大幅下滑。不过，罚款占各金融机构自有资本的比例均不超过4.2%，因此预计整体上对资本充足率的影响有限。韩国信用评价公司解释称，主要券商拥有相对雄厚的资本实力，且上半年业绩良好，已具备较强的利润缓冲能力。受到制裁的机构可能提出异议申请或提起撤销诉讼，但仅凭撤销诉讼不能停止缴纳罚款；如果法院不予准许停止执行，即使仍在诉讼期间，也可能先行缴纳罚款。韩国信用评价公司首席研究员尹素晶表示：“今后将持续审查此类财务负担对各公司创利能力和资本充足率的影响，并将其纳入信用评价。尤其是在证券行业下半年经营环境转趋不利的情况下，一旦确认与罚款相关的费用，盈利能力下滑压力可能进一步加大。”如有发现请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布以及用于人工智能训练和利用。2026年11月16日14时58分发稿

The two countries have decided to set up a Joint Working Group to explore the Terms of Reference for a Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA) or Free Trade Agreement (FTA) to facilitate stronger bilateral trade, improve access to both markets and promote investment linkages between the two countries. These issues figured during the India-Egypt Joint Trade Committee (JTC) meet, which was co-chaired by Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal and Mohamed Farid Saleh, Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade of Egypt, in Cairo on Sunday (November 15, 2026). Currently, the bilateral trade is at $6.5 billion and both sides are targeting to double it in the coming years. The discussions also focused on strengthening business exchanges and encouraging joint manufacturing and investment, it said. Priority sectors included pharmaceuticals and medical devices, engineering and electrical equipment, fertilisers, textiles, renewable energy and emerging technologies. Opportunities for Indian investment in Egyptian industrial zones, as well as Egyptian investment in India's expanding manufacturing and services sectors, also formed an important part of the meeting, it added. Both sides expressed interest in strengthening the framework agreement between Invest India and Egypt's General Authority for Investment and Free Zones, including a proposed digital platform for sharing investment information and facilitating business linkages. Egypt's proximity to the Suez Canal and its connectivity with African, Arab and European markets makes it a valuable partner for export-oriented manufacturing and regional supply chains. Addressing a session, Mr. Goyal proposed a four-point action agenda ahead of the 80th anniversary of India-Egypt diplomatic relations in 2027. The Ministry said Egypt's strategic location linking the Mediterranean and Red Seas, its expanding ports and logistics infrastructure, and access to African, Arab and European markets offer opportunities for Indian businesses seeking to establish manufacturing and export-oriented operations. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/p.body_zh:
订阅账户还可享受《Premium Stories》、社论、观点等更多内容。使用 Subscription 即可解锁这些权益。

印度与埃及已讨论如何减少非关税壁垒、简化海关流程、强化标准并改善市场准入，目标是将双边贸易额 nearly double 至 $12 billion。一份官方声明于星期一（2026年11月16日）公布了上述情况。两国决定成立联合工作组，研究优惠贸易协定（PTA）或自由贸易协定（FTA）的职权范围，以推动双边贸易进一步发展、改善两国市场准入，并促进两国之间的投资联系。

印度与美国已就印度商品进入美国市场获得优惠准入达成一致：戈亚尔

此外，两国还讨论了解决影响企业运营的问题，包括产品注册和贸易相关监管程序。这些问题在印度—埃及联合贸易委员会（JTC）会议上得到讨论。11月15日星期日（2026年），该会议在开罗举行，由商务与工业部长皮亚ush·戈亚尔和埃及投资与对外贸易部长穆罕默德·法里德·萨利赫共同主持。委员会借机审查现有贸易联系，评估企业面临的挑战，并确定新的深化合作领域。

商务与工业部表示：“双方重申扩大双边贸易的承诺，并将目标定为 $12 billion。双方强调，有必要使贸易多元化、推动增值出口，并解决贸易相关挑战。”

目前，双边贸易额为 $6.5 billion，双方均希望在未来几年将其翻一番。声明称，讨论还重点关注加强企业交流，以及鼓励联合制造和投资。重点行业包括制药和医疗器械、工程和电气设备、化肥、纺织品、可再生能源及新兴技术。

声明补充说，Indian 企业在埃及工业区投资的机会，以及埃及企业在印度不断扩大的制造业和服务业领域投资的机会，也构成此次会议的重要内容。双方均表示有意加强 Invest India 与埃及投资与自由区总局之间的框架协议，包括拟议建设一个数字平台，用于共享投资信息和促进商业联系。

埃及毗邻苏伊士运河，并与非洲、阿拉伯和欧洲市场相连，因此是出口导向型制造业和区域供应链的重要合作伙伴。

在一场会议发言中，戈亚尔先生提出，在印埃外交关系建立80周年（2027年）之前实施四点行动计划。商务部表示，埃及连接地中海和红海的战略区位、日益扩大的港口和物流基础设施，以及进入非洲、阿拉伯和欧洲市场的便利条件，为寻求建立制造业和出口导向型业务的印度企业提供了机会。

双方商定，下一次联合贸易委员会会议将于2028年在新德里举行，或在双方均认为方便的更早日期举行。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.title_zh: 富川市敦促将GTX-G线路纳入第五次国家铁路网建设计划
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111611.body_zh: （坡川＝韩联社）记者노승혁＝韩国京畿道坡川市于16日表示，最近在首尔专门建设会馆举行的“铁路大转型全民意见征集”活动中，GTX坡川争取引进推进委员会及市政府相关人士等40余人出席，并强调有必要将首都圈广域快速铁路（GTX）G线纳入第五次国家铁路网建设计划。此次活动由国土交通部主办、韩国交通研究院主管，旨在第五次国家铁路网建设计划（2026～2035）制定前分享铁路政策愿景与目标，并广泛征集地方政府、专家和国民的意见。活动以韩国交通研究院关于国家铁路网建设计划的发表为开端，随后进行广域地方政府意见听取、专家讨论和国民意见征集。当天在坡川，以GTX坡川争取引进推进委员长李民赫为代表的委员会成员、坡川市政府及素洼邑相关人士等40余人出席，呼吁建设GTX-G线的必要性，并将其纳入国家计划。尤其是自2024年起，以民间主导的GTX坡川争取引进推进委员会为中心开展公开讨论活动和全民签名征集活动，共获得345425人的签名，扩大了争取引进该线路的社会共识。GTX坡川争取引进推进委员会强调，GTX-G线有助于改善接壤地区恶劣的交通条件，促进首都圈北部地区均衡发展，并带来经济和社会效益。委员会说明，坡川为维护国家安全长期承受各种限制，具有地区特殊性，并传达了GTX-G线应纳入国家铁路网建设计划的意见。第五次国家铁路网建设计划是国土交通部制定的铁路领域最高法定计划，是决定今后新铁路项目推进方向的重要依据。坡川市长白永贤表示：“争取引进GTX是坡川市民长期以来的夙愿，也是改善坡川交通环境的重要课题。”他说：“我们将与市民一道努力到底，争取GTX-G线能够被纳入第五次国家铁路网建设计划。”另一方面，GTX-G线是李在明总统第21届总统选举公约中包含的项目，是一条总长84.4公里的广域快速铁路线路，连接坡川松梧、义政府、别内、구리、논현、사당、光明（KTX），直至仁川 숭의。报道可通过KakaoTalk okjebo了解。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、复制及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月16日14时56分发布。
