https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The US government is doubling down on its immigration control, with the State Department revoking over 6,000 visas belonging to foreigners engaged in or facilitating birth tourism. The department announced on Thursday, through its X handle, that its Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force had revoked the visas of people identified as involved in the practice. “The Department of State’s Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force has now revoked more than 6,000 visas from foreigners who engaged in or facilitated birth tourism,” the post read. It also said the task force is still identifying and “holding accountable everyone involved in this illicit practice.” This implies that more visas are likely to be revoked over this practice in the future. Birth tourism refers to travelling to another country, usually while pregnant, to give birth so the child can acquire that country’s citizenship or nationality by birth. The latest action signals a wider crackdown on both participants and facilitators, including those who help arrange such travel. Last month, the department announced that it had revoked over 4,000 visas, and that 700 of the revoked visas belonged to Chinese nationals. The latest statement, however, did not provide a breakdown by nationality. As such, it remains unclear whether Nigerians were among those affected. A core aspect of President Donald Trump’s “America first” policy and political campaigns has been a crackdown on immigration. The US leader, during his presidential campaigns, pledged to increase deportations of people living in the country, restrict asylum and refugee admissions, and tighten both illegal and some legal immigration pathways. Since resuming office, Mr Trump has implemented several policies aligned with this agenda. At the inauguration ceremony, for instance, he signed an executive order declaring illegal immigration a national emergency and ordered the speedy deportation of undocumented migrants. The United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement crackdown on migrants has, in the past year, been criticised for human rights violations. The Trump administration also imposed visa bans on several countries, including Nigeria. It is also planning to introduce a policy requiring foreign nationals in the US seeking to change their status from temporary visa holders to permanent residents to return to their home country to apply for a Green Card
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 美国在打击“生育旅游”行动中撤销了6,000多份签证
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 美国政府正在加强移民管控。美国国务院吊销了6,000多张签证，持证人均为参与或协助“生育旅游”的外国人。该部门周四通过其X账号宣布，其“生育旅游防范特遣队”已吊销被认定参与这一行为者的签证。帖文称：“美国国务院生育旅游防范特遣队现已吊销6,000多张签证，涉及参与或协助生育旅游的外国人。”帖文还表示，特遣队仍在查明并“追究所有参与这一非法行为者的责任”。这意味着，未来可能还会因这一行为吊销更多签证。生育旅游是指前往另一个国家，通常在怀孕期间前往当地生产，使孩子通过出生取得该国国籍或身份。最新行动表明，美国正在更广泛地打击参与者和协助者，包括帮助安排此类旅行的人。上个月，该部门宣布已吊销4,000多张签证，其中700张被吊销的签证属于中国公民。不过，最新声明没有提供按国籍划分的明细。因此，目前尚不清楚尼日利亚公民是否在受影响的签证持有人之列。严厉打击移民一直是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普“美国优先”政策和政治竞选的核心内容之一。美国领导人在竞选期间承诺增加对居住在美国的外国人的驱逐力度，限制庇护和难民接收，并收紧非法移民以及部分合法移民通道。特朗普复任以来，已实施多项符合这一议程的政策。例如，在就职典礼上，他签署行政命令，将非法移民宣布为全国紧急状态，并下令迅速遣返无证移民。过去一年，美国移民与海关执法局针对移民的执法行动因侵犯人权而受到批评。特朗普政府还对包括尼日利亚在内的多个国家实施签证禁令。该政府还计划推出新政策，要求在美国希望从临时签证持有人身份转为永久居民的外籍人士返回其原籍国申请绿卡

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周五在会见中国外交部长王毅时表示，朝鲜半岛和平符合韩国和中国的共同利益，并呼吁加强双边沟通，推动半岛局势发展。赵显在开场发言中说：“朝鲜半岛问题事关韩国的重大利益，半岛的和平与稳定符合两国共同利益。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun said Friday that peace on the Korean Peninsula serves the shared interests of South Korea and China during a meeting with his Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, calling for stronger bilateral communication to advance the situation on the peninsula. The ministerial talks took place in Beijing ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen next week, where President Lee Jae Myung and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to meet. "The Korean Peninsula issue is a vital interest for South Korea, and peace and stability on the peninsula serve the shared interests of both countries," Cho said in his opening remarks. "I hope the two countries will continue to strengthen strategic communication to make progress on the situation on the Korean Peninsula," he added, expressing hope that a meeting between the two leaders in Shenzhen would provide an opportunity to further develop their strategic cooperative partnership. Wang said bilateral relations had returned to a normal track following the leaders' reciprocal visits last year and early this year, stressing the need to maintain high-level exchanges and further develop their strategic partnership. Noting that bilateral trade is expected to reach a record high this year, he expressed hope that people-to-people exchanges would recover to around 10 million annually. With the two countries hosting the APEC summit consecutively, Wang called for joint efforts to promote regional development and prosperity, expressing hope that the upcoming summit would give fresh momentum to bilateral ties. South Korea hosted last year's APEC summit in the southeastern city of Gyeongju. At that time, the two ministers exchanged views on bilateral relations and Korean Peninsula issues, with Cho calling for Beijing to play a constructive role in bringing North Korea back to dialogue. Before departing for Beijing for a two-day visit earlier in the day, Cho said he and Xi planned to discuss issues that need to be coordinated ahead of the APEC summit, as well as North Korea-related matters, including the possibility of U.S.-North Korea talks. Other issues on the agenda include pending bilateral matters, such as ways to enhance economic and cultural exchanges and cooperation, as well as Chinese structures installed in the Yellow Sea. The talks come amid deepening ties between China and North Korea, following Xi's visit to Pyongyang in June and a series of high-level exchanges between the two countries. Wang accompanied Xi during his visit to the United States in August. He was also present during Kim's surprise visit to the Chinese border city of Dandong last month. Inter-Korean relations, however, remain frozen. Pyongyang defines ties with Seoul as those between two hostile states and has rejected the Lee Jae Myung administration's calls for dialogue. There has been speculation about a possible meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during Trump's trip to Asia for the APEC summit, as the U.S. president has expressed interest in resuming dialogue with Pyongyang. Asked whether he believes China is willing to mediate between Washington and Pyongyang, Cho expressed uncertainty over how actively Beijing might pursue such efforts. "I don't think there is much chance of China actively inviting (Kim) to the APEC summit for talks, but it is still too early to tell," the minister said. A South Korean presidential official said Thursday that a meeting between Trump and Kim on the sidelines of the APEC summit was unlikely, while noting that it was difficult to predict whether contact between the two leaders might take place before or after the summit
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 赵兑烈在会见王毅期间表示，朝半岛和平符合韩国与中国的共同利益
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周五在会见中国 counterparts 王毅时表示，朝鲜半岛的和平符合韩国和中国的共同利益，并呼吁加强双边沟通，推动半岛局势发展。这场部长级会谈在北京举行，先于下周在深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会；韩国总统李在明和中国国家主席习近平预计将在峰会上会晤。赵显在开场发言中说：“朝鲜半岛问题是韩国的核心利益，半岛的和平稳定符合两国共同利益。我希望两国继续加强战略沟通，推动朝鲜半岛局势取得进展。”他还表示，希望两国领导人在深圳会晤能为进一步发展战略合作伙伴关系提供机会。王毅表示，在两国领导人去年及今年年初相互访问后，双边关系已回到正常轨道，并强调需要保持高层交往，进一步发展战略伙伴关系。他指出，预计今年双边贸易额将创历史新高，并希望民间交往恢复到每年约1000人次的水平。鉴于两国将连续主办APEC峰会，王毅呼吁共同努力，促进区域发展与繁荣，并希望即将举行的峰会为双边关系注入新的动力。韩国去年在东南部城市庆州主办了APEC峰会。当时，两国外长就双边关系和朝鲜半岛问题交换了意见，赵显呼吁北京在促使朝鲜重返对话方面发挥建设性作用。当天早些时候，在启程前往北京进行为期两天的访问之前，赵显表示，他与习近平计划讨论APEC峰会前需要协调的议题以及与朝鲜有关的事务，包括举行美朝会谈的可能性。议程中的其他议题还包括尚未解决的双边事务，例如加强经济文化交流与合作的办法，以及黄海上的中国设施。会谈是在中国与朝鲜关系日益密切的背景下举行的。此前，习近平于6月访问平壤，两国之间进行了一系列高层交往。8月习近平访问美国时，王毅陪同出访。上个月，朝鲜最高领导人金正恩突然访问中国边境城市丹东时，王毅也在场。然而，朝韩关系仍陷于僵局。平壤将首尔关系定义为两个敌对国家之间的关系，并拒绝李在明政府提出的对话倡议。随着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普赴亚洲出席APEC峰会，外界一直在猜测特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩可能会晤，因为这位美国总统已表示有兴趣恢复与平壤的对话。当被问及是否认为中国愿意在华盛顿与平壤之间进行调解时，赵显对北京会多积极地推进相关努力表示不确定。这位部长说：“我认为中国主动邀请（金正恩）参加APEC峰会会谈的可能性不大，但现在下结论还为时过早。”一名韩国总统府官员周四表示，特朗普与金正恩在APEC峰会期间会面的可能性不大，同时指出，难以预测两位领导人是否会在峰会前或峰会后进行接触

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: The Korean government on Friday kept its price caps on fuel products unchanged for a fifth consecutive period amid elevated international oil prices and continued tensions in the Middle East, the industry ministry said. The maximum prices at which local refiners can supply gasoline, diesel and kerosene to gas stations will remain unchanged at 1,784 won ($1.3), 1,773 won and 1,380 won per liter, respectively, for the four weeks beginning Saturday, according to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources. The government has kept the caps at their current levels for 20 weeks since June 27, following a reduction on June 26. "International oil prices fell below $100 per barrel, with Brent crude reaching $96 per barrel on Nov. 12. However, the price remains more than $20 higher than at the end of June," the ministry said. The freeze is aimed at easing upward pressure on consumer prices amid elevated oil prices and high ocean freight costs, it added. The government introduced the fuel price caps in mid-March to stabilize domestic fuel prices amid supply chain disruptions stemming from the U.S.-Iran war in the Middle East. It plans to adjust the emergency measures as necessary while closely monitoring developments in the Middle East and economic conditions at home

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title: Ex-vice minister brings Shakespeare to life with AI music
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary: Former official drops chamber folk album adapting classic sonnets Yong Ho-seong, former vice minister of culture, sports and tourism, is stepping into a bold new chapter of his creative life by using artificial intelligence (AI) technology to set classical literature to music. 10, breathing contemporary musical life into 15 of William Shakespeare's sonnets through AI-assisted composition and vocals.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 前官员推出商会民谣专辑，改编经典十四行诗。前文化、体育和旅游副部长 Yong Ho-seong 正利用人工智能（AI）技术为古典文学谱曲，开启艺术生涯大胆崭新的篇章。他借助 AI 辅助作曲和演唱，为威廉·莎士比亚的15首十四行诗注入当代音乐生命力，共推出10张唱片。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Former official drops chamber folk album adapting classic sonnets Yong Ho-seong, former vice minister of culture, sports and tourism, is stepping into a bold new chapter of his creative life by using artificial intelligence (AI) technology to set classical literature to music. Performing under the stage name Dr. Dragon, Yong released his debut full-length album, "Fragile Beauty," on Nov. 10, breathing contemporary musical life into 15 of William Shakespeare's sonnets through AI-assisted composition and vocals. The release marks the first installment of "DiVerse," an ambitious ongoing project to set all 154 of Shakespeare's sonnets to modern music. The idea was sparked by a hardcover edition of Shakespeare's complete sonnets that a British friend gifted him during his tenure as director of the Korean Cultural Centre UK. "The name reflects both Shakespeare's original verse and the newly written lyrics, as well as the diverse musical genres used to reimagine centuries-old classics," Yong told The Korea Times during an interview in Seoul, Thursday. The former vice minister explained that the album's sound production leans into late-1960s avant-garde folk and chamber folk, driven by nylon-string guitars, upright contrabass, cellos, violas, flutes, harmoniums and bass clarinets, while featuring the contralto tones of his AI vocal persona NikkiD. "Rather than big, sweeping arrangements, the quiet, intimate sound of late-1960s chamber folk felt like the right fit for these poems," Yong said. Yong’s journey into music creation is rooted in a lifelong passion. Long before entering government service, he studied classical music and jazz extensively and built a massive personal collection of over 10,000 records. While serving as a government official, he also debuted as a music critic in 1993 after winning an annual music criticism competition hosted by the prominent performing arts magazine Auditorium. He has also spent decades playing drums in jazz and rock bands. After retiring from his career as a high-ranking bureaucrat last year — during which he played a pivotal role in establishing major cultural institutions and drafting key legislation — Yong turned his sights toward AI. In July, he won the AI.LOVE.JAZZ. composition competition in Montreux, Switzerland, with "Frozen Edge," a vocal jazz piece inspired by Shakespeare's Sonnet 97. For Yong, AI is not a replacement for human artistry, but an essential creative tool. "AI is a loyal assistant that expands the possibilities of songwriting and production," the creator said. "I write detailed prompts spanning a full page to specify rhythm, instrumentation and musical references, and sometimes regenerate a track 30 or 40 times before editing individual tracks myself until I find the exact sound I envision." Comparing AI to the historical introduction of digital sampling in popular music decades ago in the 1980s, the former official believes that technology ultimately broadens the base of music creators rather than diminishing human value. Rather than requiring years of formal composition training, individuals with a clear artistic perspective can now use these tools to bring their musical concepts to life, he added. "Just like sampling decades ago, AI acts as a faithful assistant that expands the pool of people who can create music, making the process far more efficient for everyone," Yong said. Looking ahead, he envisions how this collaborative approach could even transform traditional education by allowing students to turn personal stories and daily emotions into original songs. "When students learn to turn their daily experiences into melodies, music becomes a powerful tool for self-expression," Yong said. Following the release of "Fragile Beauty," Yong plans to issue a new sonnet-inspired album every month, spanning genres from jazz and blues to hip-hop, rap-metal and K-pop. He has already reached out to various Shakespeare-related societies, associations and academic institutions around the world to explore educational and cultural collaborations. He is also developing progressive rock operas based on Shakespeare's tragedies, such as "Hamlet" and "Macbeth," alongside a project reinterpreting the poetry of Joseon Dynasty poet Yi Mae-chang (1573-1610). "Just as I am reimagining Shakespeare, I wanted to bring the poignant and soul-searching poetry of Yi Mae-chang into contemporary folk and blues," Yong said. While the former vice minister devotes up to six hours a day to composing and two hours of practicing drums, Yong said his creative ventures are fueled by personal fulfillment rather than commercial success. He recently earned his first-ever revenue as a musician by composing a theme song for T&C Foundation, a public interest foundation, though the ex-official primarily views his creative output as a natural extension of a well-prepared second act in life. "For me, happiness is not about the high intensity of achievements, but the frequency of joyful moments," Yong said. "Whether it is practicing drums in the morning or giving classical literature a new voice through modern music, I am simply enjoying a life where I can freely explore what I love."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 前副部长借助人工智能音乐让莎士比亚鲜活起来
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh:
前官员发行室内民谣专辑，以人工智能改编古典十四行诗
前文化、体育和旅游部副部长龙浩成正以人工智能（AI）技术为古典文学谱曲，开启创意人生的大胆新篇章。他以艺名“Dragon博士”演出，11月10日发行首张完整专辑《脆弱之美》，通过人工智能辅助作曲和人声演绎，为威廉·莎士比亚的15首十四行诗注入当代音乐生命力。这次发行是“DiVerse”计划的第一部分；该雄心勃勃的持续项目旨在将莎士比亚全部154首十四行诗谱成现代音乐。这一构想源于一位英国朋友在他担任韩国文化中心英国主任期间送给他的《莎士比亚十四行诗全集》精装版。龙浩成周四在首尔接受《韩国时报》采访时表示：“这个名字既反映莎士比亚的原诗，也体现新创作的歌词，以及重新演绎百年经典时采用的多样音乐类型。”这位前副部长介绍，专辑的声音制作以20世纪60年代末的前卫民谣和室内民谣为主，由尼龙弦吉他、立式低音提琴、大提琴、中提琴、长笛、风琴和低音单簧管支撑，并展现其人工智能人声形象NikkiD的女中音音色。龙浩成说：“与宏大、层层铺陈的编曲相比，20世纪60年代末室内民谣安静而亲密的声音，更适合这些诗。”
龙浩成投身音乐创作，源于一生的热爱。早在进入政府部门之前，他就广泛学习古典音乐和爵士乐，并收藏了1万多张唱片。担任政府官员期间，他还在1993年赢得知名表演艺术杂志《Auditorium》主办的一年一度音乐评论比赛，首次以乐评人身份登台。他还花了数十年时间在爵士和摇滚乐队中担任鼓手。去年从高级官僚职位退休——任职期间，他在建立重要文化机构和起草关键立法方面发挥了关键作用——后，龙浩成将目光转向人工智能。今年7月，他凭借受莎士比亚第97首十四行诗启发创作的声乐爵士作品《冰冻边缘》，在瑞士蒙特勒赢得AI.LOVE.JAZZ.作曲比赛。这位创作者表示，对龙浩成而言，人工智能不是人类艺术创作的替代品，而是一种不可或缺的创作工具。他说：“人工智能是一名忠实的助手，扩大了歌曲创作和制作的可能性。我会写满整整一页的详细提示词，规定节奏、乐器配置和音乐参考，有时还会将一首曲子重新生成30或40次，再亲自编辑各个音轨，直到找到自己设想的确切声音。”
这位前官员将人工智能与20世纪80年代数字采样技术首次引入流行音乐作比较，认为技术最终拓宽了音乐创作者的群体，而非削弱人的价值。他补充说，人们不必再经过多年的正规作曲训练，只要拥有清晰的艺术视角，如今就能利用这些工具让音乐构想成为现实。龙浩成说：“就像几十年前的采样一样，人工智能是一名忠实的助手，扩大了能够创作音乐的人群，让每个人的创作过程都高效得多。”
展望未来，他设想这种协作方式甚至可以改变传统教育，让学生能够将个人故事和日常感受转化为原创歌曲。龙浩成说：“当学生学会把日常经历化为旋律时，音乐就成为自我表达的强大工具。”继《脆弱之美》发行后，龙浩成计划每月推出一张受十四行诗启发的专辑，涵盖爵士、布鲁斯、嘻哈、说唱金属和K-pop等多种风格。他还联系了世界各地与莎士比亚有关的社团、协会和学术机构，探讨教育与文化合作。他也在根据莎士比亚的悲剧创作前卫摇滚歌剧，如《哈姆雷特》和《麦克白》，同时推进一个重新诠释朝鲜王朝诗人李梅昌（1573—1610）诗歌的项目。龙浩成说：“就像我重新演绎莎士比亚一样，我也希望把李梅昌那些动人、直击灵魂的诗歌带入当代民谣和布鲁斯。”
这位前副部长每天最多投入六小时作曲，并花两小时练习鼓乐。龙浩成说，他的创作动力来自个人满足感，而非商业成功。他最近通过为公益基金会T&C Foundation创作主题曲，首次获得音乐人生的第一笔收入；但这位前官员主要把自己的创作成果视为充分准备的人生第二幕的自然延伸。龙浩成说：“对我来说，快乐不在于成就的高强度，而在于欢乐时刻的频率。无论是清晨练鼓，还是通过现代音乐为古典文学赋予新声，我只是在享受一种能够自由探索所爱之物的生活。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: The Korean government said Friday that Google has complied with security requirements imposed as a condition for allowing the transfer of high-precision map data overseas. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said a government-led consultation body reviewed Google's implementation of security measures following its conditional approval in February to export 1:5,000-scale digital map data. The review found that the global tech giant had implemented measures to prevent the exposure of geographic coordinates, as well as sensitive military and security facilities, on its global Google Maps and Google Earth services, including web and mobile platforms. To meet the requirements, Google developed a dedicated control system for Korea and introduced safeguards to block app updates if they risk exposing restricted geographic coordinates. In August, Google also signed an agreement to obtain satellite imagery processed for security purposes by the National Geographic Information Institute (NGII) through a local partner. Google is said to have chosen the local navigation company, TMAP Mobility, to process base map data, according to industry sources. Under the agreement, Google must replace existing imagery on its map services as soon as it receives the security-processed images, without making any modifications. Currently, Naver Map, operated by the local portal giant Naver Corp., is the most widely used service in the country, with monthly active users of 31.2 million in October, according to data from market tracker Mobile Index. TMAP came next with 15.1 monthly active users, followed by Kakao Map with 13.8 million users and Google Map with 10.5 million users locally
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 韩国政府：Google遵守韩国对高精度地图数据的安全要求
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 韩国政府周五表示，Google 已遵守相关安全要求；这些要求是允许其向海外传输高精度地图数据的附加条件。国土交通部表示，政府牵头的咨询机构审查了 Google 在2月获准出口比例尺为1:5,000的数字地图数据后所采取安全措施的落实情况。审查发现，这家全球科技巨头已在旗下 Google Maps 和 Google Earth 服务（包括网页端和移动端）实施相关措施，防止泄露地理坐标以及敏感的军事和安全设施。为满足有关要求，Google 为韩国开发了一套专用控制系统，并设置安全防护机制，在应用更新可能暴露受限地理坐标时予以阻止。今年8月，Google 还签署了一项协议，将通过一家本地合作伙伴获取由国家地理信息院（NGII）出于安全目的处理的卫星图像。据行业消息人士称，Google 选择了本地导航企业 TMAP Mobility 处理基础地图数据。根据该协议，Google 在收到经过安全处理的图像后，必须立即替换其地图服务中的现有图像，且不得作任何修改。据市场追踪机构 Mobile Index 的数据，目前由本地门户网站巨头 Naver Corp. 运营的 Naver Map 是韩国使用最广泛的服务，10月月活跃用户达到3120万。TMAP 以1510万月活跃用户紧随其后，Kakao Map 和 Google Map 在当地的月活跃用户分别为1380万和1050万

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.summary_zh: （北京、首尔=韩联社）韩中首席特派记者金智宪报道：外交部长赵显13日就朝鲜半岛问题呼吁中国发挥建设性作用。中国外交部长王毅表示，中国对朝鲜半岛的政策没有改变，并将继续为朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定发挥建设性作用。外交部表示，两位外交部长当天下午在北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行会谈并共进晚餐，双方就韩中关系、朝鲜半岛问题等共同关心的事项交换了意见，会谈持续3小时。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.body: (베이징·서울=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 김지헌 기자 = 조현 외교부 장관이 13일 한반도 문제와 관련한 중국의 건설적 역할을 당부했다. 왕이 중국 외교부장은 중국의 한반도 정책에는 변함이 없다면서 한반도 평화·안정을 위한 건설적 역할을 지속해 나갈 것임을 재확인했다. 외교부는 두 장관이 이날 오후 중국 베이징 댜오위타이(釣魚臺) 국빈관에서 3시간에 걸쳐 외교장관회담과 만찬을 갖고 한중 관계와 한반도 문제 등 상호 관심사에 대해 의견을 교환했다고 밝혔다. 조 장관은 한반도의 평화·안정이 한중 양국의 공동 이익임을 강조했고 한반도 비핵화와 평화 실현을 위한 정부의 노력을 설명했으며 북한의 대화 복귀 등 한반도 문제에서 중국의 역할을 당부했다. 왕 부장은 이에 대해 답하면서 '비핵화' 표현을 명시적으로 쓰지 않는 최근의 태도를 이어갔지만, 비핵화가 포함되는 기존의 중국 대한반도 정책에 변함이 없다는 입장을 반복했다. 왕 부장은 지난 8월 서울에서 조 장관과 외교장관회담을 벌였을 때도 '한반도 문제에 대한 중국의 입장은 연속적이고 안정적'이라는 취지로 언급한 바 있다. 회담에서 조 장관은 정부가 작년 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 의장국으로서 내주 개최되는 선전 APEC 정상회의의 성공적 개최를 기원한다고 했다. 이어 선전에서 양국 정상 간 교류가 한중 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 더욱 성숙하게 발전시키는 중요한 계기가 될 수 있도록 잘 준비해 나가자고 했다. 왕 부장은 한중 관계의 긍정적 흐름이 작년 경주에서 선전으로 이어지고 있음을 평가하면서 이재명 대통령의 선전 APEC 계기 방중을 환영하며 충분한 예우를 갖춰 이번 방문이 성공적으로 이루어질 수 있도록 하겠다고 화답했다. 양 장관은 작년과 올해 양국 정상의 상호 국빈방문을 통한 한중관계 전면 복원의 흐름이 구체 성과로 나타나고 있음을 평가하고, 내년 수교 35주년을 맞아 양국 국민이 체감할 수 있는 실질적인 성과를 지속 창출해 나가기 위한 여러 방안에 대해 논의했다. 특히 한중 자유무역협정(FTA) 서비스·투자 협상 진전을 통해 양국의 수평적·호혜적 경제협력의 기반을 강화해 나가는 한편 양 국민 간 인적교류를 확대하고 우호정서를 증진하기 위한 노력도 강화해 나가자는 데도 의견을 같이 했다. 조 장관은 서해 문제 등 사안에서 한국의 원칙적 입장을 전달했으며 중국 내 한국 국민의 안전과 권익 보호를 위한 중국 정부의 노력도 당부했다. 이와 관련해 양 장관은 이런 사안들이 양국 관계 발전에 걸림돌이 되지 않도록 세심하게 관리해 나가자는 데 공감했다고 외교부가 전했다. 회담의 본격적 시작에 앞서 조 장관은 모두발언을 통해 "한반도 문제는 대한민국의 사활적 이익이며 한반도 평화와 안정은 양국의 공동이익"이라며 "한반도 정세 진전을 위해 양국 간 전략적 소통을 계속 강화해 나가기를 기대한다"고 말했다. 이어 "다음 주 선전에서 양국 정상이 10개월 만에 다시 만나 한중 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 더욱 성숙하게 발전시켜 나가는 중요한 계기를 만들 것으로 기대한다"며 "경주에서 시작된 두 정상 간 우정과 신뢰의 이야기가 베이징을 거쳐 선전으로 이어지면서 한중 관계도 더욱 돈독해지기를 희망한다"고 말했다. 조 장관은 지난해 11월과 올해 1월 양국 정상의 상호 국빈 방문 이후 한중 관계가 전면 복원의 흐름을 공고히 해왔다고 평가했다. 그러면서 "올해 한중 인적 교류는 1천만명을 돌파할 것으로 예상된다"며 "한중 간 교역도 40% 넘게 증가했다"고 말했다. 이어 "이는 양국 정상 간 전면적 관계 복원에 대한 공동 인식을 이행하기 위해 양국 정부가 긴밀히 소통하며 함께 노력해온 결과"라고 강조했다. 조 장관은 이번 회담을 통해 다음 주 양국 정상의 만남이 성공적으로 이뤄질 수 있도록 협의하기를 기대한다고 덧붙였다. 왕 부장은 모두발언에서 "지난해 말과 올해 초 시진핑 국가주석과 이재명 대통령의 성공적인 상호 방문으로 중한 관계가 개선과 발전의 정상 궤도로 돌아왔다"고 평가했다. 이어 "다음 단계의 고위급 접촉을 준비하는 것이 매우 필요하다"며 "내년 중한 수교 35주년을 계기로 양국이 함께 노력해 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 올바른 궤도로 발전시켜 나가야 한다"고 강조했다. 왕 부장은 올해 양국 교역액이 사상 최고치를 기록할 것으로 전망하면서 인적 왕래도 연간 1천만명 수준을 회복할 것으로 기대했다. 그는 다음 주 선전 APEC 정상회의에 이 대통령을 비롯한 여러 회원국 정상이 참석하기로 확정됐다며 한국이 지난해 경주 APEC 정상회의를 성공적으로 개최했다고 평가했다. 그러면서 "중한 양국이 잇따라 APEC 회의를 개최하는 만큼 손을 맞잡고 아시아태평양 공동체 건설을 함께 추진해 역내 공동 발전과 번영을 촉진해야 한다"고 말했다. 왕 부장은 한국이 중국의 APEC 개최 준비에 적극적으로 참여하고 기여한 점도 높이 평가하며 선전 정상회의가 양국 관계에 새로운 동력을 제공할 것이라는 기대를 나타냈다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/13 23:47 송고 2026년11월13일 23시47분 송고 (베이징=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 = 13일 오후 중국 베이징 댜오위타이 국빈관에서 조현 외교부장관과 왕이 중국 외교부장 등이 참석한 가운데 한중 외교장관 회담이 열리고 있다. 2026.11.13. https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.title_zh: 赵兑烈呼吁中国在半岛问题上发挥建设性作用；王毅表示政策没有改变（综合）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.body_zh: （北京、首尔＝韩联社）韩中阁特派记者金智宪报道＝外交部长赵显13日敦促中国在朝鲜半岛问题上发挥建设性作用。王毅表示，中国对朝鲜半岛的政策没有变化，并重申将持续为朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定发挥建设性作用。外交部表示，两国外长当日下午在北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行会谈并共进晚餐，历时3小时，就韩中关系、朝鲜半岛问题等双方共同关心的问题交换了意见。赵部长强调，朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定符合韩中两国的共同利益，并介绍了韩国政府为半岛无核化与和平实现所作的努力，同时敦促中国在朝鲜重返对话等半岛问题上发挥作用。王毅在回应时延续了近来未明确使用“无核化”表述的做法，但再次强调，中国既有的半岛无核化政策没有变化。王毅还表示，去年8月在首尔与赵部长举行外长会谈时曾提及，中国对半岛问题的立场具有连续性和稳定性。会谈中，赵部长表示，作为去年亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议主席国，韩国政府希望下周在宣城举行的APEC领导人会议取得圆满成功。他接着说，双方应做好充分准备，使两国领导人之间的交流成为推动韩中全面战略合作伙伴关系进一步成熟发展的重要契机。王毅评价，韩中关系的积极势头正从去年庆州延续至宣城，并表示欢迎李在明总统借APEC会议之机访问中国，将给予充分礼遇，确保此次访问取得成功。两位外长评价，通过去年和今年两国领导人相互进行国事访问所推动的韩中关系全面恢复趋势正在转化为具体成果，并就迎接明年建交35周年、持续为两国国民带来切实成果的多种方案进行了讨论。双方尤其同意，将通过推进韩中自由贸易协定（FTA）服务与投资谈判，进一步夯实两国平等、互利的经济合作基础，同时加强扩大两国国民之间的人员交流以及促进友好感情的努力。赵部长转达了韩国在黄海问题等议题上的原则立场，并敦促中国政府为保护在中国韩国国民的安全和权益而努力。外交部介绍，围绕这些议题，双方同意将审慎管控，避免其成为两国关系发展的障碍。会谈正式开始前，赵部长在全体发言中表示：“朝鲜半岛问题关系到韩国的切身利益，朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定符合两国共同利益。”“我们期待韩中两国继续加强战略沟通，为半岛局势取得进展作出贡献。”他接着说：“我们期待下周在宣城，两国领导人时隔10个月再次会晤，并以此为重要契机，推动韩中全面战略合作伙伴关系进一步成熟。”他还说：“希望从庆州开启的两位领导人之间的友谊与信任故事经由北京延续到宣城，同时期待韩中关系更加亲近。”赵部长评价，去年11月和今年1月两国领导人相互进行国事访问后，韩中关系全面恢复的趋势进一步巩固。他强调：“预计今年韩中人员交流将突破1000万人次，两国之间的贸易额也增长了40%以上。”“这是两国政府为落实两国领导人全面恢复关系的共同共识而紧密沟通、共同努力的结果。”赵部长补充说，希望通过此次会谈协商，推动下周两国领导人会晤取得成功。王毅在全体发言中评价：“去年底和今年初，习近平主席与李在明总统成功进行相互访问，推动中韩关系重回改善与发展的正确轨道。”他接着强调：“为筹备下一阶段的高层接触，必须做好充分准备。”“明年正值中韩建交35周年，两国应以此为契机共同努力，推动全面战略合作伙伴关系沿着正确轨道发展。”王毅预计，今年两国贸易额将创历史新高，人员往来也将恢复到每年1000万人左右的水平。他表示，包括李在明总统在内的多个成员国领导人已确定出席下周在宣城举行的APEC领导人会议，并评价韩国去年成功举办庆州APEC领导人会议。他表示：“既然韩中两国接连举办APEC会议，两国就应携手并进，共同推进建设亚太命运共同体，促进地区共同发展与繁荣。”王毅还高度评价韩国积极参与并助力中国筹备APEC会议，并期待宣城领导人会议为两国关系提供新动力。图片来源：KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和应用> 2026/11/13 23:47发稿 2026年11月13日23时47分发稿（北京＝韩联社）韩中阁特派记者＝13日下午，在中国北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行韩中外长会谈，外交部长赵显、中国外交部长王毅等人出席。2026.11.13. https://www.myjoyonline.com/how-a-sex-sc.summary: Republican representative John Moolenaar, who chairs the House Select Committee on China, said it was in the national interest for Nvidia and other American AI firms to succeed, but that companies "should never jeopardise our nation's security" by giving Chinese firms access to their most advanced chips. The White House has not responded to the BBC's request for comment. Jensen Huang's personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/how-a-sex-sc.summary_zh: 担任美国众议院中国问题特别委员会主席的共和党议员John Moolenaar表示，让Nvidia及其他美国人工智能企业取得成功符合国家利益，但这些企业“绝不应危及我国安全”，也不应让中国企业接触其最先进的芯片。白宫尚未回应BBC的置评请求。Jensen Huang的个人生活或许引发了这场危机，但如今相关疑问已延伸至白宫本身。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/how-a-sex-sc.body: The Nvidia boss was one of the few business leaders with direct access to the US president. He had met Trump repeatedly, travelled with him to Britain and, in May, joined him on Air Force One for his trip to China. Jensen Huang wasn't just another tech billionaire seeking the president's ear. He had become an important voice in one of the biggest arguments inside the administration: how much of America's most advanced technology should be allowed to reach China. Nvidia makes the chips that power the AI revolution. Washington has restricted exports of its most advanced processors to China since 2022, believing they could help Beijing develop its military and technological capabilities. But enforcing those restrictions is difficult. Chips can be bought legally by customers in countries such as Singapore and Malaysia and then diverted to China. Chinese companies can also rent access to computing power through data centres outside the country. Jensen Huang has long argued that the restrictions are counterproductive. They shut Nvidia out of a huge market and encourage Chinese companies to develop their own alternatives. Trump appeared sympathetic to this view, allowing Nvidia to resume sales of certain chips to China last year in return for a share of the revenue, although its most advanced Blackwell chips remain off limits. The allegations surrounding Jensen Huang's reported affair with Alice Huang, of no relation but a former executive at Singapore-based company Megaspeed, have raised the possibility that a foreign intelligence operation was targeting not just a powerful businessman, but someone with unusually close access to the American president. US intelligence reportedly suspects Alice Huang of having links to Chinese intelligence. Beijing has rejected the allegations. Nvidia's board says it has no reason to believe company secrets or national security were compromised. But the affair has opened up a much bigger question: what did the administration in Washington know, and what did it do about it? His department was responsible for controlling exports of sensitive American technology. It was also being pressed to act on concerns about Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer suspected of helping divert advanced chips to China. On Thursday, Megaspeed chief executive, Tan Yong Pong, also known as James Tan, said the company "takes its compliance obligations under US export control laws extremely seriously" and is "committed to working constructively and transparently with the US government". He said the company had co-operated with US Commerce Department inspections. A highly classified memo was shared with Lutnick about the concerns surrounding Alice Huang and Megaspeed. He resisted taking action against the company, a decision that is now under scrutiny. Other senior officials wanted a tougher response. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was among those who reportedly questioned why Megaspeed had not been placed on the Commerce Department's blacklist. There were also questions about why an investigation into the Singapore-based company was stopped after Nvidia intervened. The New York Times reported that Nvidia's general counsel contacted Commerce Department investigators probing suspected chip smuggling by Megaspeed, invoking a senior Trump appointee. The department allegedly then froze its investigation and handed the case to the Justice Department. This apparently highlighted a significant disagreement about the direction of Trump's China policy. Huang wanted access to the Chinese market. Other officials were supposedly worried about the national security consequences. Lutnick was caught in the middle. Members of Congress from both parties want answers. Democrats have launched an investigation into how the Commerce Department vetted Chinese companies approved to buy AI chips. Republicans are also questioning the administration's approach. Republican representative John Moolenaar, who chairs the House Select Committee on China, said it was in the national interest for Nvidia and other American AI firms to succeed, but that companies "should never jeopardise our nation's security" by giving Chinese firms access to their most advanced chips. Senator Elizabeth Warren, the top Democrat on the Senate Banking Committee, said Huang's resignation did not absolve him of responsibility, and urged Lutnick to explain why export control loopholes remain open. Meanwhile Jensen Huang's team told Republican lawmakers on Wednesday that he plans to cooperate with their request to testify behind closed doors. The White House has not responded to the BBC's request for comment. It has, however, told the New York Post that Trump has complete confidence in Lutnick, describing him as "the most transformative commerce secretary in modern history". That is a fairly emphatic show of support, particularly amid reports that officials are weighing whether Lutnick should be forced out. There are some obvious questions. If Lutnick had indeed been warned about the risks, why did his department fail to act? And if other senior officials were indeed pressing for action, why did it take so long? The BBC has contacted the Commerce Department for comment. But there is an even bigger question for Trump. The president cultivated a close relationship with Huang. He was directly involved in decisions about chip sales to China. And, according to reporting in the New York Times, he was briefed on the intelligence concerns. This is becoming difficult to dismiss as the misjudgement of one businessman or one government department. Jensen Huang's personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself. How much influence did he have? What did the president know? And who was ultimately responsible for protecting America's most sensitive technology?
https://www.myjoyonline.com/how-a-sex-sc.title_zh: Nvidia 的性丑闻如何给白宫施压
https://www.myjoyonline.com/how-a-sex-sc.body_zh: 英伟达老板黄仁勋是少数能够直接接触美国总统的企业领袖之一。他曾多次与特朗普会面，陪同他前往英国，并于5月搭乘美国空军一号随行访问中国。黄仁勋并非又一个试图向总统进言的科技富豪。他已成为本届政府内部最大争论之一中的重要声音：美国应允许多少最先进技术流入中国？英伟达制造驱动人工智能革命的芯片。自2022年以来，华盛顿一直限制英伟达向中国出口最先进的处理器，认为这些芯片可能帮助北京发展军事和技术能力。但执行这些限制并不容易。客户可以在新加坡、马来西亚等国家合法购买芯片，随后转售至中国。中国企业还可通过租用境外数据中心的算力来获取计算资源。黄仁勋长期认为，这些限制会适得其反。它们让英伟达被排除在一个庞大市场之外，并促使中国企业开发自己的替代产品。特朗普似乎认同这一观点，去年允许英伟达恢复向中国销售部分芯片，以换取部分收入分成，但其最先进的Blackwell芯片仍禁止出口。有关黄仁勋据报与Alice Huang有婚外情的指控掀起了更多疑问。Alice Huang与黄仁勋没有亲属关系，曾任职于总部位于新加坡的公司Megaspeed。这些指控表明，外国情报行动的针对目标可能不仅是一位权势显赫的商人，还是一位与关系异常密切的美国总统接触频繁的人。据报道，美国情报部门怀疑Alice Huang与中国情报机构有关联。北京否认了这些指控。英伟达董事会表示，没有理由相信公司机密或国家安全受到损害。但这段婚外情引出了一个更大的问题：华盛顿政府知道多少，又采取了什么措施？他的部门负责管制美国敏感技术出口。与此同时，该部门还面临压力，需要就Megaspeed引发的担忧采取行动。这家英伟达客户被怀疑协助将先进芯片转运至中国。周四，Megaspeed首席执行官Tan Yong Pong（又名James Tan）表示，公司“极其认真地履行美国出口管制法律规定的合规义务”，并“致力于与美国政府建设性、透明地合作”。他说，公司曾配合美国商务部检查。一份高度机密的备忘录被提交给Lutnick，内容涉及围绕Alice Huang和Megaspeed的担忧。他拒绝对该公司采取行动，而这一决定如今正受到审视。其他高级官员希望采取更强硬的回应。据报道，财政部长Scott Bessent也在质疑者之列，他问Megaspeed为何未被列入商务部黑名单。还有人追问，在英伟达介入后，为何针对这家新加坡公司的调查会被终止。《纽约时报》报道，英伟达总法律顾问联系了调查Megaspeed涉嫌走私芯片的商务部调查人员，并援引了一位由特朗普任命的高级官员。随后，据称该部门暂停调查，并将案件移交司法部。这似乎凸显了特朗普对华政策方向上的重大分歧。黄仁勋希望获得中国市场准入，而其他官员则担心可能产生的国家安全后果。Lutnick夹在中间。两党议员都要求得到答案。民主党人对商务部如何审查获准购买人工智能芯片的中国企业展开调查，共和党人也在质疑本届政府的做法。共和党众议员John Moolenaar担任众议院中国问题特别委员会主席。他说，让英伟达和其他美国人工智能企业取得成功符合国家利益，但企业“绝不应”因向中国企业提供其最先进芯片的使用权而危及国家安全。参议院银行委员会首席民主党参议员Elizabeth Warren表示，黄仁勋辞职并不能免除他的责任，并敦促Lutnick解释出口管制漏洞为何仍未堵住。与此同时，黄仁勋的团队周三告诉共和党议员，他计划配合他们的要求，闭门作证。白宫尚未回应BBC的置评请求。不过，白宫告诉《纽约邮报》，特朗普完全信任Lutnick，称他是“现代历史上最具变革性的商务部长”。这是相当有力的支持，尤其是在有报道称官员正在权衡是否应迫使Lutnick下台之际。这里有一些显而易见的问题。如果Lutnick确实曾获警告风险，他的部门为何没有采取行动？如果其他高级官员确实在敦促采取行动，为何要等那么久？BBC已联系商务部置评。但对特朗普而言，还有一个更大的问题。总统与黄仁勋建立了密切关系，并直接参与了有关向中国销售芯片的决策。据《纽约时报》报道，他曾听取有关情报方面担忧的简报。这越来越难以被解释为单个商人或单个政府部门的误判。黄仁勋的个人生活可能触发了这场危机，但如今相关问题已延伸至白宫本身。他对政府有多大影响力？总统知道什么？最终，谁负责保护美国最敏感的技术？

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Bayelsa State Government has announced a partnership with a United States-based energy company to develop a gas processing facility, but the value of the proposed investment is yet to be determined, pending a feasibility assessment of gas flare sites across the state. The government said the agreement with Fulcrum LNG Incorporated was reached on Wednesday at the inaugural US-Nigeria Governors Government-to-Business (G2B) Forum on Energy, Mining and Infrastructure in Sugar Land, Texas. The announcement came after a meeting between Governor Douye Diri and the company’s Chief Executive Officer, Jesus Bronchalo. According to a statement issued by the governor’s spokesperson, Daniel Alabrah, the project will be implemented in phases, beginning with the gathering and commercialisation of gas currently being flared. The gas is expected to supply Bayelsa’s Independent Power Plant and emerging industrial clusters, while reducing environmental pollution associated with gas flaring. A subsequent phase will involve an integrated gas monetisation and development plan to harness the state’s gas reserves. However, the financial commitment to the Bayelsa project remains unclear. Although the government publicised the deal as a $100 million investment, Mr Bronchalo said the actual investment requirement would only be determined after a comprehensive field study of the state’s flare sites. He said the assessment would determine the locations of the facilities, the volume of gas being flared and whether the problem resulted from inadequate infrastructure to transport the gas or insufficient reinjection capacity. Mr Bronchalo also cautioned that some flare sites could be too remote or economically unviable for gas gathering. He said the company would finance the project entirely, although the state government would have to contribute capital if it wanted an equity stake. The company’s chief executive said the period from the final investment decision to commissioning would be about 12 months. He cited a similar project the company is undertaking in Guyana, which he valued at about $3 billion, as an indication of its experience in gas infrastructure development. Fulcrum LNG was selected by the Guyanese government in June 2024 to help develop gas infrastructure for the monetisation of the country’s natural gas resources. The selection followed a competitive process involving 17 bidders. The Guyana project was intended to involve the design, financing, construction and operation of gas infrastructure, although its development has faced questions about financing and implementation. PREMIUM TIMES sent a media enquiry to Mr Alabrah, seeking clarification on the reported $100 million investment, the status of the agreement, Fulcrum LNG’s financial commitment, the gas flare sites identified for the project and the proposed ownership and funding arrangements. Mr Alabrah, in a text message to PREMIUM TIMES, said there was no cause for alarm and that Westpaq International, the facilitator of the deal, would respond to the newspaper’s questions. He said he had forwarded the enquiry to the company’s chief executive officer and promised to provide further information once he received a response. The newspaper had yet to receive a response as of the time of filing this report. Responding to the agreement, Mr Diri described the partnership as a win-win arrangement, saying it was important to reducing environmental pollution and supporting industrialisation. He said his administration was ready to facilitate the project’s commencement, noting that it had about 15 months remaining in office. Earlier, during his presentation at the forum, the governor said Bayelsa holds an estimated 15 to 20 per cent of Nigeria’s proven gas reserves and supplies about 60 per cent of the gas used by Nigeria LNG Limited in Bonny, Rivers State. He also highlighted the state’s 203-kilometre Atlantic coastline and the proposed Agge Deep Seaport as investment opportunities. The forum, facilitated by Westpaq International in collaboration with the United States Department of Commerce and the US Commercial Service in Houston, brought together representatives of Bayelsa, Nasarawa, Ogun and Ondo states and more than 15 American energy, mining and financial companies. The Bayelsa delegation included the governor’s Honourary Adviser on Oil and Gas, Daru Owei; Managing Director of Bayelsa State Electricity Company, Olice Kemenanabo; Director-General of Bayelsa Investment Promotion Agency, Patience Abah; and Chief Executive Officer of Century Energy Group, Ken Etete
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: 巴耶尔萨州宣布与美国达成天然气工厂协议，但投资金额仍不确定
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 巴耶尔萨州政府已宣布与一家总部位于美国的能源公司达成合作，将开发一座天然气处理设施，但在对该州各地天然气燃烧点进行可行性评估之前，拟议投资的价值仍无法确定。政府表示，与Fulcrum LNG Incorporated的协议于周三在得克萨斯州舒格兰举行的首届美尼州长政府与商业论坛能源、矿业和基础设施分会期间达成。此前，州长Douye Diri曾与该公司首席执行官Jesus Bronchalo会面。根据州长发言人Daniel Alabrah发表的声明，该项目将分阶段实施，首先收集并商业化利用目前正在燃烧的天然气。这些天然气预计将供应巴耶尔萨州的独立发电厂和新兴产业集群，同时减少天然气燃烧带来的环境污染。后续阶段将制定综合天然气变现与开发计划，以利用该州的天然气储备。然而，州政府尚未明确对该项目承诺的资金规模。尽管政府对外宣称这笔投资为1亿美元，但Bronchalo先生表示，只有在对该州天然气燃烧点进行全面实地研究后，才能确定实际投资需求。他说，评估将确定设施选址、正在燃烧的天然气量，以及问题究竟源于天然气运输基础设施不足，还是回注能力不足。Bronchalo先生还警告称，部分燃烧点可能过于偏远，或在经济上不具备天然气收集条件。他说，该公司将全额资助该项目，但州政府如希望持有股权，则必须注资。该公司首席执行官表示，从最终投资决定到投产大约需要12个月。他援引该公司在圭亚那实施的类似项目作为其天然气基础设施开发经验的证明，并称该项目估值约30亿美元。2024年6月，圭亚那政府选定Fulcrum LNG协助开发天然气基础设施，以变现该国天然气资源。此次遴选经过有17家投标人参与的竞争程序。圭亚那项目原计划涉及天然气基础设施的设计、融资、建设和运营，但其开发进程在融资和实施方面受到质疑。PREMIUM TIMES向Alabrah先生发出媒体问询，要求澄清有关1亿美元投资的报道、协议进展、Fulcrum LNG的资金承诺、项目所选定的天然气燃烧点，以及拟议的股权和资金安排。Alabrah先生通过短信回复PREMIUM TIMES称，没有必要惊慌，交易协调方Westpaq International将答复该报的问题。他说，已将问询转交给该公司的首席执行官，并承诺在收到答复后提供更多信息。截至本报道发稿时，该报尚未收到答复。针对这项协议，Diri先生将双方合作描述为互利共赢安排，称其对减少环境污染和支持工业化十分重要。他说，其政府已准备为项目启动提供协助，并指出距本届政府任期届满约剩15个月。此前，州长在论坛发言时表示，巴耶尔萨州估计拥有尼日利亚已探明天然气储量的15%至20%，并供应尼日利亚LNG Limited在河流州博尼使用的约60%的天然气。他还强调，该州拥有203公里的大西洋海岸线，拟议中的Agge Deep Seaport也具有投资机会。此次论坛由Westpaq International与美国商务部及美国商务部休斯敦商业服务局合作协调，汇集了巴耶尔萨州、纳萨拉瓦州、奥贡州和翁多州的代表，以及15家以上的美国能源、矿业和金融企业。巴耶尔萨州代表团包括州长石油与天然气事务荣誉顾问Daru Owei、巴耶尔萨州电力公司董事总经理Olice Kemenanabo、巴耶尔萨州投资促进局局长Patience Abah，以及Century Energy Group首席执行官Ken Etete

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The remains of two Korean independence fighters laid to rest in the United States and Uzbekistan will return home next week to mark the 80th anniversary of a project to repatriate the remains of such activists from overseas, the veterans ministry said Friday. It marks the first time that the remains of an independence fighter buried in Uzbekistan will return home.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国退伍军人部周五表示，安葬在美国和乌兹别克斯坦的两位韩国独立运动人士遗骸将于下周回国，以纪念从海外迎回此类活动人士遗骸项目实施80周年。这标志着安葬在乌兹别克斯坦的独立运动人士遗骸首次回国。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The remains of two Korean independence fighters laid to rest in the United States and Uzbekistan will return home next week to mark the 80th anniversary of a project to repatriate the remains of such activists from overseas, the veterans ministry said Friday. The remains of Ho Si-han and Lee Gwal will be brought back from the U.S. and Uzbekistan, respectively, on Sunday, according to the ministry. It marks the first time that the remains of an independence fighter buried in Uzbekistan will return home. An event marking their return will be held at a memorial park in Seoul on Monday, attended by some 300 personnel, and the remains will later be buried at the national cemetery in the central city of Daejeon. Ho, born in Seoul in 1885, was arrested by the Japanese police while raising military funds following the March 1 independence movement against Japan's 1910-45 colonial rule of Korea. He also took part in a number of fundraising schemes to support the Korean independence movement from 1927 to 1945, before he died in Los Angeles in 1956. The Korean government posthumously awarded him the Aejok Order of Merit for National Foundation in 2021 over his role in the country's independence. Lee, born in North Hamgyong Province in 1898, moved to Manchuria and actively participated in Korean national organizations in Russia's far eastern region of Primorsky Krai in 1919. He also served as the diplomatic delegate of the Korean Provisional Government in the early 1920s, but he was later deported to Uzbekistan in 1937, where he died. Lee was awarded the National Foundation Medal in 2009. The repatriation comes as part of civilian and government-led efforts that began with the return of the remains of three renowned Korean independence fighters, including Yun Bong-gil, in 1946 and have continued for 80 years. Meanwhile, the ministry has identified 240 tombs in total of Korean independence fighters buried across 10 countries, including China, the U.S. and Kazakhstan, and plans to bring their remains back home after consulting with their bereaved families. The veterans ministry said 158 sets of remains of independence fighters have been so far repatriated from 14 countries
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 两名韩国独立运动人士的遗骸将从美国和乌兹别克斯坦运回韩国
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国 veterans ministry 周五表示，两名分别安葬在美国和乌兹别克斯坦的韩国独立运动人士的遗骸将于下周回国，以纪念从海外迎回此类活动人士遗骸计划80周年。据该部透露，Ho Si-han和Lee Gwal的遗骸将分别于周日从美国和乌兹别克斯坦运回。这是首次迎回一位安葬在乌兹别克斯坦的独立运动人士遗骸。纪念他们归国的活动将于周一在首尔的一座纪念公园举行，约有300人参加，随后遗骸将被安葬在大田市中心的国家公墓。Ho于1885年出生于首尔，在日本殖民统治朝鲜的1910年至1945年间，他曾参加反对日本殖民统治的3月1日独立运动并筹集军费，后被日本警察逮捕。1927年至1945年间，他还参与了多项支持韩国独立运动的筹款活动，之后于1956年在洛杉矶去世。鉴于他在韩国独立事业中的贡献，韩国政府于2021年追授他爱国建国勋章。Lee于1898年出生于朝鲜咸镜北道，1919年移居满洲，并积极参与俄罗斯远东滨海边疆区的韩国人组织。20世纪20年代初，他还担任韩国临时政府的外交代表，但后来于1937年被驱逐至乌兹别克斯坦，并在那里去世。Lee于2009年获颁建国勋章。这次迎回遗骸是民间和政府共同推动的工作的一部分；该工作始于1946年迎回包括Yun Bong-gil在内的三名著名韩国独立运动人士遗骸，并持续了80年。与此同时，该部已在包括中国、美国和哈萨克斯坦在内的10个国家确认了240处韩国独立运动人士墓葬，并计划在与遇难者家属协商后将其遗骸迎回国内。韩国 veterans ministry 表示，截至目前，已从14个国家迎回158具独立运动人士遗骸

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's rice output declined for the fifth consecutive year in 2026 amid changing dietary habits, data showed Friday, with the cultivation area also reaching a new low. Rice production decreased 0.9 percent year-on-year to 3.5 million tons this year, according to data compiled by the Ministry of Data and Statistics. It marked the fourth-lowest level since the government began compiling the data in 1965. The combined area of rice paddies in the country fell 1.1 percent year-on-year to 670,000 hectares, the smallest on record. Despite the decline in overall production, output per 1,000 square meters increased 0.2 percent year-on-year to 524 kilograms this year, according to the ministry. Rice remains a staple food in Korea, but consumption has steadily fallen in recent decades amid shifts in dietary preferences. The decrease in production also came amid the government's efforts to manage output while encouraging farmers to switch to other crops. By region, South Jeolla Province and Gwangju together produced 736,000 tons of rice, followed by South Chungcheong Province with 681,000 tons and North Jeolla Province with 526,000 tons, the government findings showed

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/t.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Senior Congress leader and MP Shashi Tharoor has alleged that 115 of the 315 speakers invited to the second edition of the Bharat Summit in Hyderabad were denied entry into India or had their visas cancelled, “apparently on the instructions of the Union Ministry of Home Affairs”. Mr. Tharoor, who is in Hyderabad for the Bharat Summit, in a post on social media platforms, questioned the legal basis for the action and said it was unclear under which provision of law the government had taken such a step. He pointed out that the summit would conclude on Saturday (November 14, 2026), making it impossible to reverse the decision in time for the affected participants to attend. “What a shame that a proud democracy has become so insecure that it must stifle any voices it fears will be critical!” he wrote. His allegations came in the wake of a Norwegian journalist Helle Lyng claiming that she had been advised by the Indian Embassy not to travel to India despite holding a valid visa to participate in the summit. She works for the Oslo-based newspaper Dagsavisen. Earlier, Congress MP and Telangana Congress media in-charge Chamala Kiran Kumar Reddy had also alleged that nearly 30% of the invitees could not travel to India because of visa-related issues. Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi is scheduled to participate in the valedictory session on Saturday. The controversy has raised questions over the participation of international delegates at the two-day summit, which seeks to bring together nearly 1,000 participants from India and around 70 countries. The event is being held against the backdrop of the 80th year of India’s Independence and the 137th birth anniversary of the country’s first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru. Mr. Tharoor said the summit would also focus on establishing a think tank, ‘Our World Institute’, and creating a platform for dialogue and cooperation between the Global South and the Global North. The allegations come amid political controversy over the event, with the BJP calling it an “anti-India summit” and accusing Mr. Gandhi of giving a platform to forces opposed to the country’s interests. BJP leaders in Telangana have announced plans to protest against his visit to Hyderabad. Union Coal Minister G. Kishan Reddy, addressing a press conference in New Delhi on Thursday, termed the Bharat Summit an “anti-India summit”. The BJP alleged the event was meant to bring together forces critical of India and questioned the Congress leadership’s motives for organising it. Telangana BJP president N. Ramchander Rao questioned the rationale behind holding such an event in the State when the government was facing financial constraints. He accused Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy of spending public money to sponsor what he described as anti-India forces, in order to please Mr. Rahul Gandhi. The BJP’s criticism has added a political dimension to the controversy surrounding the summit, particularly following allegations that several international speakers and invitees were unable to travel to India because of visa-related issues. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/t.body_zh:
订阅账户还可享受《Premium Stories》、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅即可解锁这些权益。

资深国会议党领袖兼议员沙希·塔鲁尔称，在海得拉巴举行的第二届 Bharat Summit 邀请了315名发言人，其中115人被拒绝入境印度或签证遭取消，“显然是根据联邦内政部的指示”。塔鲁尔先生目前正在海得拉巴参加 Bharat Summit。他在社交媒体平台发文，质疑这一行动的法律依据，并表示不清楚政府依据法律中的哪一项条款采取了这一措施。他指出，峰会将于星期六（2026年11月14日）闭幕，因此受影响者不可能及时推翻这一决定并参会。他写道：“一个引以为豪的民主国家竟变得如此缺乏安全感，以至于必须压制任何它认为可能提出批评的声音，真是可悲！”

这些指控是在挪威记者 Helle Lyng 声称自己尽管持有参加峰会的有效签证，仍被印度使馆建议不要前往印度之后提出的。她供职于总部位于奥斯陆的报纸《Dagsavisen》。此前，国会议员兼特伦甘纳邦国大党媒体负责人 Chamala Kiran Kumar Reddy 也曾指控，近30%的受邀者因签证相关问题无法赴印度。

人民院反对党领袖拉胡尔·甘地计划于星期六参加闭幕会议。这场争议引发了对国际代表参与这场为期两天的峰会的疑问。此次峰会旨在汇集来自印度及约70个国家的近1,000名参与者。活动是在印度独立80周年暨该国首任总理贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁诞辰137周年的背景下举行的。

塔鲁尔先生表示，峰会还将重点关注成立一个名为“Our World Institute”的智库，并搭建全球南方与全球北方之间的对话与合作平台。

这些指控出现之际，该活动正引发政治争议。印度人民党称其为“反印度峰会”，并指责甘地先生为反对国家利益的势力提供平台。印度人民党在特伦甘纳邦的领导人宣布计划抗议他访问海得拉巴。联邦煤炭部长 G. Kishan Reddy 星期四在新德里举行的新闻发布会上称 Bharat Summit 是“反印度峰会”。印度人民党声称，该活动旨在召集批评印度的势力，并质疑国大党领导层举办此次活动的动机。

特伦甘纳邦印度人民党主席 N. Ramchander Rao 质疑，在政府面临财政约束的情况下在该邦举办此类活动的原因。他指责首席部长 A. Revanth Reddy 花费公共资金赞助他所谓的反印度势力，以取悦拉胡尔·甘地先生。

在多名国际发言人和受邀者因签证相关问题无法赴印度的指控之后，印度人民党的批评又为围绕此次峰会的争议增添了政治层面的争论。
